content:
在北京首都国际机场，现在规定，乘客落地后，必须先将随身行李过安检机扫描，然后才能离开到达大厅。然而，当我提着行李走向安检传送带时，看到了一个我从未见过的标志：任何携带无人机的乘客都必须将其取出并申报。一名中国安检人员直接指着那个标志，确认我的行李中是否携带无人机。我摇头表示没有。我通常不带无人机旅行。
那个标志并不是我此次行程中看到的唯一新鲜事物，只是众多新事物之一。自20世纪90年代初以来，我经常前往中国旅行，但我发现这次旅行完全不同，而且有一个很具体的原因：这是我在人工智能全面爆发的时代首次访问中国。
结束了为期九天的中国之行——期间我访问了北京、雄安，以及杭州、宁波和深圳等中国科技中心——我非常清楚地看到，人工智能时代已经在重塑美中两国的地缘政治和地缘经济关系，一方面，它实际上正在地缘政治层面拉近两国的距离；另一方面却加剧了双方的贸易分歧。
为什么这么说？让我们回到北京机场那个关于无人机的标志。它告诉了我们什么？它告诉我们，尽管美中两国仍然是为了争夺优势而相互角力的经济和战略竞争对手，但两国都意识到，在这两个超级大国的紧密结合之中，现在出现了一个闯入者——那个拥有超强赋能的恶意行为者。
我指的不是中国的民主倡导者。我说的是制造混乱的势力——诈骗犯、毒贩、人口贩子，以及那种刚刚从币安盗走63亿美元加密货币的黑客。我指的是，现在那些恶意的个人和小团队可以用现成的无人机或人工智能驱动的网络武器武装自己，凭借一己之力就能施展出堪比超级大国的破坏力。更重要的是，我指的还有美国和中国的人工智能模型，随着它们日益具备自主决策、自我优化和自我保护的能力，正展示出越来越大的失控风险，可能成为导致大规模破坏的推手。
两国都才刚刚开始努力应对这种局面在双边交往中所要求的思维转变——尽管在从加沙到乌克兰再到伊朗的战争中，两国仍习惯性地站在对立面。上周在北京吃晚饭时，一位中国博主朋友坦诚地对我说：“在台湾等问题上，我们仍然有实质性的分歧。但有时美国和中国已经不知道他们到底在争什么了，”他说。“这只是一种习惯罢了。”
好吧，这是一个两国都必须摒弃的过时习惯，而且要快；在人工智能时代，全球稳定将越来越需要世界上这两个人工智能超级大国之间建立起确保相互协作的关系。
诚然，我们对“混乱”的定义往往与中国不同。美国采纳的任何监管体系都需要保护民主价值观、言论自由和和平抗议。中国的监管框架中很可能不包含这些内容。但我们的自身利益之间仍然存在很多重叠之处——防止人工智能对基础设施、个人、国家乃至整个人类造成暴力伤害。这正是华盛顿和北京应该能够达成共识、需要加以控制的那种混乱。我们比以往任何时候都更需要这些基本规则，因为人工智能的下一步发展，从字面意义上来说，就是“行走”——就像机器人那样。
在北京的一场人工智能机器人展览上，我看到了一项演示：一台中国制造的人形机器人自行更换了背部安装的电池组，整个过程仅用了几分钟。当我目不转睛地看着它完成这一操作时，我不禁思考：如果它还具备自主智能，会发生什么呢？
尽管为了共同应对那些企图将人工智能技术用于恶用目的的势力，北京和华盛顿在地缘政治层面可能会随着时间推移而走得更近，但在地缘经济层面，情况很可能恰恰相反。
这是因为人工智能同时也在极大地增强另一股力量：中国庞大的制造业机器。截至2024年，中国生产的制造业产品已占全球销售总量的近三分之一。在这次旅行中，我参观了一些中国最先进的汽车公司和电信制造商，我看到人工智能正在进一步提高它们的效率和竞争力。
从贸易统计数据中可以清楚地看到这一点。2025年中国的贸易顺差——出口额减去进口额——达到了惊人的1.19万亿美元。这比前一年增长了20%。今年预计将增长到1.3万亿美元——这种与全球经济产出严重失衡的贸易状况，自第二次世界大战结束以来，任何国家都未曾出现过，而二战后美国还是唯一幸存的主要工业经济体！
因为，当美国公司正耗资数十亿美元投资于前沿人工智能模型——它们如此先进，令最顶尖的数学家都自叹不如，中国公司正专注于部署廉价、“够用”的开源权重人工智能模型，这可能使其在先进制造业中的巨大领先优势变得根本无法逾越。换种说法，美国正斥巨资开发前沿人工智能模型，这些模型已经如此强大，以至于最新版本因为太危险而无法发布。相比之下，中国在迈入人工智能时代的时候，已拥有如此强大的先进制造业基础，因此即使采用规模较小但“够用”的人工智能模型，也能立即获得广泛的收益。
当你将这一点与中国的牛仔式资本主义（国内经济各个领域都有大量企业展开激烈竞争）结合起来，你会发现，某些行业的进步速度简直令人害怕。在北京机器人产业园，也就是我看到那个机器人自行更换电池组的地方，另一个展品给我留下了更深刻的印象。
那是两个并排站立的人形机器人。它们由不同的中国公司制造，准备参加北京亦庄举办的人形机器人半程马拉松赛——赛程全长21公里。第一个机器人跑者脖子上挂着一条系有金牌的绶带，它在2025年的比赛中曾以2小时40分42秒的成绩获胜。第二个机器人跑者也佩戴着金牌，它在今年4月举行的同一赛事中以50分26秒的成绩获胜，打破了当时由雅各布·基普利莫保持的57分20秒的人类世界纪录。
仅仅在一年之内，中国在具身人工智能方面的进步就创造出一个比有史以来跑得最快的人类还要快的机器人马拉松选手。我的中国向导指着这两个机器人说：“去年，今年。明年——我们走着瞧。”
我们当然会走着瞧。除此之外，伙计们……这里似乎没什么好担心的了。
以下是我通过在中国的数十次交谈和公司考察所了解到的，关于人工智能时代如何重塑中国以及中美关系的情况。
六个月前，如果你问起几乎任何一位人工智能专家：中美两国是否会坐下来就一套规范达成共识，管控如今日益危险的人工智能模型？你得到的答案会是：“绝不可能”——而且对方会特别强调，中国永远不会同意这样的事情。现在，重新想想吧。
眼下，我想说北京实际上可能比特朗普总统更渴望讨论人工智能的监管框架，特朗普曾在9月份对联合国表示，美国“拒绝任何构建控制人工智能的全球主义计划企图”——在几天后与习近平主席举行峰会后，他又重申了这一主题。特朗普向世界传达的意思是：美国的前沿人工智能模型处于领先地位，我不会给它们套上枷锁。说完了。滚吧。
在雄安举行的2026年全球治理论坛开幕式上，我与中国外交部长兼政治局委员王毅以及亚洲协会董事会共同主席约翰·桑顿进行了讨论。王毅明确支持多边人工智能安全保障机制，这让我印象深刻。
正如王毅对我们所说的：“中美作为人工智能第一梯队国家，有能力也有责任共同发展好、管控好人工智能，确保其发展始终受控于人、造福于民。我们不仅要防范风险，也要开展合作，共同商讨全球适用的规则标准”，以确保人工智能发展始终受控于人、造福于民。
当然，与美国一样，中国也正在构建人工智能工具，以增强用于海外作战的武器，并升级其国内监控工具箱中的每一项工具，以控制国内的异见声音。但北京也知道——正如机场那个“行李中禁止携带无人机”的标志所显示的那样——人工智能是一把双刃剑，可能会被许多恶意行为者利用。正因如此，当你向美国政府官员询问中方在幕后针对美国采取了哪些行动时，得到的会是一个复杂的回答。
这些官员不抱任何幻想，鉴于美国在该领域处于领先地位，北京自然希望对美国的前沿模型设置更多限制。但他们也会告诉你，最近，中国的执法机构在打击网络犯罪、欺诈和洗钱方面，与美国同行的合作变得更加密切——所有这些犯罪活动都在被人工智能迅速增强。中国人知道，中国公司发布的开源权重人工智能模型比硅谷的前沿模型更容易让软件开发者（包括那些恶意行为者）改编为特定的、针对性强的应用。
但别只听我的一面之词。今年9月，中共最高情报官员、国家安全部部长陈一新在《中国网信》杂志上撰文指出，新兴人工智能技术正在“直接威胁”中国的政治、制度和意识形态安全。陈一新还说：“各种敌对势力和别有用心之人滥用……生成式人工智能技术”，制造谣言、传播虚假信息，并且“低成本、批量化……煽动对立情绪”。
陈一新的政府拥有世界上最大规模的由国家运行的面部识别监控系统，它可以庞大的人群中精准锁定单个目标——我称之为“大角色以小规模行动”。 陈一新所表达的意思是，他也知道人工智能是一种双重用途技术，它正在使得小角色如今也能以大规模行动。这正是世界地缘政治格局发生巨大变化的本质——廉价、精密的技术（如无人机和网络黑客工具）正日益扩散，现在人工智能又为这些技术注入了强劲动力。这种获得超强赋能的新行为体可能是另一个国家、也可能是一个外国人，或者是你本国的一个公民。不管怎样，这都是一个亟待全新重大对策的全新重大问题。
正因如此，当我上周在中国时，看到政府发布了一份人工智能规则草案，赋予执政的共产党新的权力，以追踪或限制某些中国先进系统的出口，对此我毫不感到惊讶。为什么是现在？也许是因为，正如《纽约时报》10月14日报道的那样，据说由中国科技巨头腾讯运行的测试中的人工智能智能体最近出现了失控，除了搞出一些恶作剧之外，还试图“绕过网站上的反机器人保护机制”。是的，中国人在他们最大的人工智能模型上也遇到了和我们一样的问题，即便他们的能力比我们落后六个月到一年。
所以，我要在这里大胆预测一下：在未来一年里，中美两国将认真探索对人工智能模型实施协同控制。因为，随着美国的前沿模型达到通过递归自我改进（无需人类指导）实现100%自我训练的程度，以及中国通过知识蒸馏向我们学习的开源权重模型随之变得越来越强大，我预测，2027年将成为两国完全领悟到这一点的一年：人工智能对人类来说是多么惊人的机遇，同时又是多么前所未有的威胁。
这种合作对美国来说将非常棘手。因为与美国政府不同，习近平主席领导的中国政府不仅担心人工智能会在国内为犯罪分子赋能，还担心它为政治对手赋能。如何应对这种复杂局面，恰恰是人工智能时代中美关系与以往不同的关键所在。
考虑到所有这些相互拉扯的力量，中美两国可能无法像两国所需的那样，彻底制定出一套共同的人工智能监管框架——至少在没有一场“完美人工智能风暴”的情况下无法做到。也就是说，一场由人工智能驱动的大规模事件，其规模大到足以吓得两国合作建立有效的控制机制，但又没有大到能导致世界末日。
我再说一遍：2027年可能就是那一年。但愿这场风暴是完美的。
现在，让我们看看人工智能如何重塑中国与美国以及世界其他地区的经济关系。我每次造访中国，都会比上一次更加深刻地感受到中国经济内部的巨大反差。如果把中国比作一个人，那么它的上半身就像一名奥运举重选手，肌肉发达，代表着出口驱动的先进制造业经济；而下半身则像一名在滑雪比赛中撞上雪墩、摔断了腿的奥运滑雪运动员，现在只能拄着拐杖蹒跚前行。
这下半身代表着中国国内经济，它仍因其长达四分之一个世纪的巨大房地产泡沫的破裂而元气大伤——这摧残了中产阶级，让数亿人背负着资不抵债的房贷或积蓄化为乌有——以至于许多中国人如今都尽可能攥紧手里的每一分钱。在21世纪初，廉价资金带来的高层公寓过度建设热潮变得如此疯狂，以至于正如《纽约时报》北京分社社长柏凯斯(Keith Bradsher)在2025年2月写道的那样，中国现在“除了为14亿人口提供了充足的住房外，也建造了足够另外3亿人居住的空置公寓”。柏凯斯在今年春天曾表示，换句话说，中国的空置公寓几乎足以容纳美国的全部人口（美国人口约为3.5亿）。
简而言之，中国是一个出口巨人，却也是一个国内消费羸弱的病人。遗憾的是，中国政府没有通过改善养老金体系等方式向国内经济注入资金，反而加倍补贴先进制造业，以巩固其全球领先地位，同时要求中国消费者默默忍受。
这正是人工智能革命初期全球经济面临的一个巨大问题。因为我在这次旅行中看到的是，中国经济中那个“奥运举重选手”部分现在正在狂饮贴着人工智能标签的蛋白质饮品，在从袜子到机器人等各个先进制造领域成为更具统治力的竞争者。
当然，美国、欧洲、日本和韩国的制造商也受益于人工智能的增强。问题在于，中国现有的先进制造业规模远远超过其他国家，因此有望从人工智能带来的变革中获得远超其他国家的收益。请随我一起进行一次旋风式的访问，参观几家中国主要的先进制造企业吧。
在杭州访问阿里巴巴总部时，集团联合创始人、主席蔡崇信的办公室主任熊雄（音）向我指出，在一级方程式比赛中，车手很少能在直道上超越对手。“胜负往往在弯道决定，”他说，“因为在弯道上，关键不在于你开得有多快，而是你有多大胆——你多晚刹车、怎么应对我的刹车——以及你有没有足够的稳定性，在高速下控制住你的车。”
或许有一天，我们回头看2019年至2023年，会发现那几年正是这样一个弯道，而中国如今已经驶出弯道，在直道上领跑。那段时期发生了两件大事：新冠疫情和人工智能浪潮相继席卷全球。由于疫情，几乎所有在华美国留学生以及许多美国企业高管都离开了中国。我也无法像往年那样每年访华。
疫情前我访问中国时，小米是一家智能手机公司。当我在2023年再来时，它也是一家电动汽车公司了。它给手机装上了四个轮子。但它并没有止步于此。上周一，当我参观其位于北京郊区、几乎完全由机器人操作的汽车厂时，我发现小米是一家超级互联、人工智能赋能的电动车企业。接待我的人提到，小米自主研发的“多元材料性能AI仿真系统”如何利用人工智能，从1016万种可能中迅速找出公司认为的最优合金配比，为其最新车身生产出强度、韧性、稳定性和低碳足迹的所谓“完美组合”。
特朗普讨厌电动汽车。他从未明白的是，中国竞争极其激烈的电动汽车产业催生出一条强大、高度整合的供应链，涵盖先进电池技术、机器人技术、材料科学，以及现在的人工智能。如今，任何想制造任何东西的中国发明家或企业家都能无缝利用这个超级高效的基础生态系统，比大多数全球竞争对手更好、更快、更便宜地创新。全球制造商过去常说，要想把产品卖到中国，就必须在中国设立业务。如今，他们则说，要想把产品卖向全世界，就必须在中国布局，并接入中国的供应链。
你想制造装有电动滚轮和闪烁彩灯的鞋子，让左脚鞋唱中国国歌、右脚鞋唱美国国歌？这里会有人在24小时内为你提供完成这项工作所需的零件和工具。
在宁波，我参观了吉利电动汽车制造厂。我看着一名工程师使用该公司最新的充电桩，用八分多钟的时间为吉利旗下最新的人工智能豪华电动汽车品牌领克的一款汽车充电，充完电足够跑约800公里。这不是笔误——这几乎就像加满一箱油一样快。“未来，我们打算进一步改进，”吉利的演示工程师轻描淡写地告诉我说。是的，我心想，我确信你们会的。
在深圳，我参观了华为最新款Mate 90智能手机的装配线。华为研发团队负责人查钧解释说，这条装配线过去每班有86名工人——主要负责人工质检——其余的劳动力是机器人。最近，通过改用具备人工智能图像识别功能的系统，将每班所需的工人数量减少到了九人。
当我问起运行这些人工智能系统使用的是什么样的数据中心时，查钧回答：“我们不需要数据中心。华为利用自身不到10亿参数的开放权重、面向特定领域的AI模型，就能获得这类制造升级所需的所有人工智能收益。” 这类模型所需的运算硬件也就一个小手提箱那么大。（参数衡量的是人工智能模型用来处理信息的连接和权重，通常用来代表其复杂性和学习能力。）查钧补充说，这些小型的人工智能模型“够用了”，能够为制造业带来巨大改善。
“够用的人工智能”是我在这次旅行中走访许多工厂时经常听到的一个表述。它描述了那些并非处于最前沿的人工智能模型为企业带来的改进。
“在人工智能方面，中美两国正走向不同的方向，”华为创始人兼首席执行官任正非在深圳的华为研究园区与我喝茶时解释道。这是该公司的众多科技中心之一，在那里雇佣了大约11万名研发人员，其中许多是拥有高学历的工程师和科学家。任正非说，在美国，人工智能研究围绕着“在今天作为一个人意味着什么？世界和上帝的意义是什么？而在中国，人工智能研究更为务实”，并正被部署在诸如钢铁这样的大型工业中。
“中国每年生产10亿吨钢铁，”他说。“如果该行业能通过使用人工智能来提高每座炼钢炉中各种化学材料混合的效率，哪怕只获得1%的改善，”一座高炉每年产生的额外利润也将超过1000万元人民币。在过去，中国并不是世界医学领域的领导者。如今在人工智能的帮助下，中国正通过快速测试不同的分子组合，惊人地加快其“发现和生产新药”的能力。
他总结道：“这就是为什么我们将美国的AI称为‘苏格拉底AI’，而将我们的方法命名为‘鲁班AI’。”鲁班是中国古代传说中的木匠大师和工程师。
现在再加上一个越来越重要的因素：稀土，它在人工智能时代将比以往任何时候都更加重要——不仅对于制造业，对于每个数据中心里所有的芯片也是如此。
此次行程的同行伙伴柏凯斯很快将出版一本名为《稀土争夺战：为什么中国正在赢得对世界最关键资源的竞争》(The Race for Rare Earths: Why China Is Winning the Contest for the World's Most Critical Resources)的书。这本书追溯了在过去几十年里，美国和欧洲如何一步步将他们在这些关键金属领域的早期领先地位输给了中国。这些金属被广泛用于汽车、无人机、风力涡轮机、战斗机、智能手机、导弹、激光器、AI芯片，以及过去40年里你能想到的几乎所有高科技发明中，包括大多数消费电子产品。
1964年，后来成为中国最高领导人的邓小平视察了位于中国北方的全球最大稀土矿。1973年，他开始规划中国在稀土技术领域的崛起。到了20世纪90年代初，他预见到了中国收紧对稀土掌控的地缘政治力量，并宣称：“中东有石油，中国有稀土。”
美国和欧洲现在才刚刚开始重启稀土产业——从矿山开采到磁体制造——但柏凯斯在书中说，至少需要五年、甚至可能10年时间才能赶上中国，该书还提出了加速复苏的建议。与此同时，北京利用其对全球关键稀土供应几近绝对的控制权迫使特朗普政府和欧盟在关税问题上屡次让步，并向日本施加巨大压力，要求其不协助台湾。
综合以上所有因素，中国在全球制造业中的主导地位是非同凡响的。中国欧盟商会主席彦辞(Jens Eskelund)引用成员提供的信息告诉我，全球90%的工业制成品是通过集装箱运输的。他说，中国在全球集装箱出口中所占的比例从2019年的31.8%上升到了2025年的37.5%。“最近几个月的每三个月滚动平均值现在已经达到了40%，”他说。原因何在？他表示，今年前八个月中国的制造业产量增长了5.3%。（同时他指出，8月份中国国内零售销售额同比仅增长了0.4%。）
彦辞告诉我，在2019年，欧洲每向中国运送一个集装箱，中国就向欧洲出口约2.5个集装箱。在2026年的前八个月，这一比例扩大到了6:1，即中国向欧洲运送六个集装箱，欧洲向中国运送一个集装箱。
“我告诉中国人：‘伙计们，如果你们不能证明能为双方创造价值，贸易就必然会变得动荡。’”彦辞补充道。“中国其实理解世界的担忧。但对中国来说，问题在于：既然世界并没有进行任何认真的抵抗，我们为什么要在意这些担忧呢？”
这是一个好问题。这促使我在结束这次行程时，作为一个相信如果两国人民都能繁荣发展，世界将会变得更加繁荣稳定的人，向中国和美国提供一些免费的建议。
对中国：你走得太远、太快，也太形单影只了。在这个过程中，你与太多发达国家和发展中国家建立了太多非双赢、而是“赢-输”的经济关系。由于国内经济疲软，加上本土工程人才的巨大优势、无与伦比的制造供应链、无可匹敌的国民职业道德以及高储蓄率，被投入到全球最顶尖的交通和电力基础设施中，中国已经无法阻止自己为全世界制造一切。
我不知道是什么时候，也不知道会以什么方式，但世界其他地区不会任由这种情况发生——尤其是在机器人和人工智能也正稳步导致更多工人失业的时候。中国正在招致真正的反弹。正如彦辞对我直言不讳地说的那样：“现在我们陷入贸易战的风险很切实。我们不会容忍一个中国包揽一切制造，而我们只能带着人去参观博物馆的世界。”
对我的美国同胞（以及我们的欧盟盟友）：中国不会放慢制造业的步伐来作为一种恩惠。如果在这个人工智能时代，我们想要影响中国的地缘政治和地缘经济，我们必须创造出迫使它做出改变的经济竞争力。这要求美国必须像这里的人们一样认真对待。
在我看来，今天的中国人正在从一个糟糕的政府体制中榨取最好的结果——通过长远思考并执行一项让他们的国家与21世纪经济趋势接轨的计划。
但中国体制的弱点之一最近戏剧性地暴露了出来：被控腐败的高级官员突然失踪和被捕——人数之多，以至于如果高层官僚害怕做出可能让他们入狱的开支决策，这可能开始拖累这里的整个系统。或者正如一位中国经济学家引用一句中国谚语对我说的那样：“水至清则无鱼”。
而美国呢？因为缺乏长远思考，任命不称职的内阁部长，并且每一届新政府都会推翻前一届政府的重大举措（比如在清洁能源方面），我们正在把一个好体制折腾出最坏的结果。
抬头看看四周吧。共和党人正斥资超过2亿美元帮助一个糟糕的人——被弹劾的得克萨斯州总检察长肯·帕克斯顿——竞选得克萨斯州参议员。特朗普正在大肆削减美国的科学研究预算，并赶走那些想来美国工作、学习和发明的最优秀的外籍人才。特朗普摧毁了电动汽车产业以迎合高油耗汽车，而民主党人则不认为让我们南部边境形同虚设是个坏主意，这反过来又有助于特朗普的再度当选。
我们要在美中（以及中欧）经济关系中恢复一些平衡，唯一的方法不是去乞求北京，而是要重建我们的筹码——再次认真对待我们的国家治理，制造具有成本竞争力的产品，以及制定目光不仅限于下周的长期计划并切实去执行。
我完全知道该怎么称呼这个战略——前几天我在一顶红色棒球帽上看到了它：“让美国再次伟大。”

title: 中国海上袭扰加剧之际，台湾加大科技能力捍卫海洋安全
source: 美国之音中文网 您可靠的信息来源

content:
台湾海巡署巡防艇对进入金门限制水域的中国海警船进行并航驱离。(2026年10月30日)
随着中国对台湾的海上袭扰持续增强，台湾也在加大以科技捍卫海洋安全的能力。台湾海洋委员会主任委员管碧玲星期一(11月2日)在一个无人载具演示活动中说，海洋是台湾的命脉，面对各种天然灾害、灰色地带侵扰及海上搜救、执法需要，台湾必须建构不受制于人的自主科技能力及海域资料库，加强海洋治理的能力。
首届“2026台湾海洋科技暨无人载具展”(MATURE Taiwan) 11月3日至5日在台南市举行，参展的五家业者在安平港以“无人载具港边演示(UXV Harborside Demo)为此次活动揭开序幕。
台湾副总统萧美琴、美国在台协会(AIT)代理副处长郭海光(Judy Kuo)及海委会主委管碧玲等人都出席活动，观看由雷虎科技、直域科技、MARTAC、BeeX及知洋科技等台湾、美国及新加坡无人载具业者演示各种水面(USV)及水下无人载具(UUV)的操作；各家业者在现场解说了包括远端遥控、自主航线规划、无人船协同编队和水下声纳感测等技术，以及各项自主技术在海域监测、海事安全及智能作业上的应用潜力。
台湾副总统萧美琴（右4)与台湾海洋委员会主任委员管碧玲（右5）在台南安平港观看2026台湾海洋科技暨无人载具展(MATURE Taiwan)一艘水面无人艇的港边演示。(2026年11月2日)
根据台湾总统府的新闻稿，萧美琴在活动上说：“今天的展示不仅涵盖海洋，也包括太空，以及透过次世代通讯连结各式科技，更是我们未来要推动的方向之一。”她强调，海洋是台湾的经济命脉，更是国家安全第一线，面对全新挑战时台湾的国防思维也必须与时俱进，希望台湾能结合与国际伙伴的产业优势，推动无人系统从技术验证走向实际部署，以跨国产业联盟打造更安全、更具韧性的产业。
“这几年，不论是俄乌战争、中东地区的情势，或是台湾面对的各式灰色地带袭扰，都让我们清楚看到，现代国家安全形态正经历剧烈变化。和平要靠实力，而实力的基础也在于整体防卫韧性，以及与国际伙伴的合作，”萧美琴说。
管碧玲则强调，此刻是台湾“迈入以科技捍卫主权、以创新守护海洋的关键时刻”。
自6月以来，中国加大对台湾周边海域的施压行动，并且在台湾东部外海展开其所谓的“执法巡查”活动，引起周边国家的担忧，美国、英国、法国及德国都发表声明表示关切，并警告北京当局在此海域开展的“海上交通专项执法”行动威胁地区稳定及航行自由。
海委会的新闻稿说，管碧玲在当天的活动中指出，台海是全球供应链重要航道，海洋是台湾的命脉与国家安全最前线，守护周边海域关系到台湾人民的生活，也关系到世界经济的稳定，台湾正在透过海洋科技与世界建立更深的链接。
“面对灰色地带侵扰、越界捞捕、海上搜救与公务执法等挑战，台湾必须建构不受制于人的自主科研能力与海域资料库，方能奠定真正的海洋治理实力，”管碧玲说。她还表示，海委会正在逐步家里台湾专属的海洋科技能力，包括建构“国家级海洋雷达观测网”，两艘海洋基础资料调查船“澄波101”、“澄波102”已在8月正式下水，朝向“自己的海自己调查、自己的资料自己掌握”跨出重要一步。
此外，海委会也在加速海巡建置无人机、无人船及相关科技装备，从空中、海面到水下达到“海空一体、全时监控、全海域感知”的立体防卫目标，接下来也将设置无人载具测试场，积极推进水面及水下载具应用发展。
台湾海巡署近来几乎每日都要应处中国海警进入台湾周边限制水域的骚扰活动。
星期一，四艘中国海警船编队进入台湾控制的金门离岛限制水域，海巡署金马澎分署随即调派四艘巡防艇前往应处，并以一对一并航监控驱离。此前已经有四艘中国海警船在上星期五进入金门限制水域。
海巡署说，中国海警船“不断以无线广播片面宣称‘台湾光复及祖国统一为历史大业’之促统言论”，海巡艇则以“两岸互不隶属，中国应认清现实立即停止无意义的骚扰行为”作为回应。
上星期六，新华社根据中国海警微信公众号报道，海警局新闻发言人姜略表示，中国海警虎狮编队当天在台湾以东海域“依法展开常态化执法巡查”，并称“10月以来，虎狮编队持续加强相关海域管控，有力保障正常航行和作业秩序，切实维护包括台湾同胞在内的中国民众合法正当权益和声明财产安全。”
海巡署当天深夜即发布新闻稿说，已运用联合情监侦手段全程严密掌握“虎狮舰”及“梅山舰”等两艘中国海警船动态，并调派“吉安舰”等舰艇持续监控中。海巡署称中国正在进行“假执法、真骚扰”的认知作战。
同日，海巡署还发现一艘中国海警船未开启船舶自动识别系统(AIS)，“以暗船方式隐匿行踪航向东沙(Pratas Islands，普拉塔斯群岛)水域”，之后又从东沙岛西方进入限制水域，海巡艇趋前强势驱离，两船对峙期间最近距离仅1海里。
海巡署说，今年迄今已在东沙水域驱离中国海警船13次、16艘次，对于中国海警船关闭AIS，以暗船模式侵扰东沙水域，海巡署重申此一企图以“假执法、真扩权”塑造管辖假象的作为只会引起台湾人民反感、破坏区域和平稳定，呼吁中方立即停止无意义的骚扰。
8艘日本巡视船驶入澎湖海域避台风，中国海警船尾随跟监，遭台湾批评危害海上安全意在制造管辖权假象

# The 5th Plenum and the CCP’S Dark Warning to the Unfaithful

14 years later, the Chinese Communist Party is still carrying out the relentless anti-corruption crusade that has become the signature program of Xi Jinping’s rule.

By [Bonnie Girard](https://thediplomat.com/authors/bonnie-girard/)

November 03, 2026

[](https://www.linkedin.com/shareArticle?url=https%3A%2F%2Fthediplomat.com%2F2026%2F11%2Fthe-5th-plenum-and-the-ccps-dark-warning-to-the-unfaithful%2F&title=The+5th+Plenum+and+the+CCP%E2%80%99S+Dark+Warning+to+the+Unfaithful "Share on LinkedIn")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fthediplomat.com%2F2026%2F11%2Fthe-5th-plenum-and-the-ccps-dark-warning-to-the-unfaithful%2F "Share on Facebook")[](https://bsky.app/intent/compose?text=The+5th+Plenum+and+the+CCP%E2%80%99S+Dark+Warning+to+the+Unfaithful%0Ahttps%3A%2F%2Fthediplomat.com%2F2026%2F11%2Fthe-5th-plenum-and-the-ccps-dark-warning-to-the-unfaithful%2F "Share on Bluesky")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=The+5th+Plenum+and+the+CCP%E2%80%99S+Dark+Warning+to+the+Unfaithful&url=https%3A%2F%2Fthediplomat.com%2F2026%2F11%2Fthe-5th-plenum-and-the-ccps-dark-warning-to-the-unfaithful%2F "Share on X")

Chinese Communist Party (CCP) General Secretary Xi Jinping addresses Chinese and foreign journalists at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing during the 20th Party Congress, Oct 23, 2022.

Credit: [Screenshot/ 中国新闻社](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%E4%B9%A0%E8%BF%91%E5%B9%B3_Xi_Jinping_20221023_01.jpg)

It used to be relatively rare to hear or see the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) publicize its vulnerabilities or engage in self-criticism. Yet, in the closing communique issued after the fifth plenum – the CCP’s recent four-day meeting from October 26 to 29 – the failings of party leadership were openly highlighted, along with the naming and shaming of dozens of members in CCP and military leadership. The very public purge is part of an ongoing anti-corruption campaign that Xi Jinping has pursued since his ascension to the top spot of general secretary of the CCP in 2012.

By releasing the communique to Xinhua, China’s official state news agency, for dissemination to the wider public, Xi becomes the hero of his own story.

“It was unanimously agreed,” [the communique said](https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202610/29/content_WS6ae348a0c6d00ca5f9a0df80.html), “that the Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core demonstrated tremendous political courage and a strong sense of responsibility in confronting the grave situation marked by weak, hollow, and watered-down party leadership, lax, superficial, and ineffective self-supervision and self-governance, as well as some startling problems within the party.”

Under Xi’s leadership, these problems have been “addressed at the root,” the report continued, and “unhealthy tendencies that had long gone unchecked have been curbed, deep-seated problems that had plagued the party for years have been remedied, and serious dangers hidden within the party, the state, and the military have been removed.”

The heavy flattery is especially interesting as, [according to the South China Morning Post](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/politics/article/3373013/chinas-fifth-plenum-cadre-promotion-rules-overhauled-focusing-problem-solving), “Xi revealed that he personally led the high-profile drafting team starting in early February 2026, working alongside Politburo Standing Committee members Wang Huning, Cai Qi, and anti-corruption chief Li Xi.”

The communique wants to make two key and crucial points at the same time. One, the CCP emphasized that there have been major operational, governance, and supervisory problems in the party for years. In the interest of openness, the communique admitted this. But, it hastened to add, many of those issues are now resolved, thanks in large part to Xi.

And yet, it seems that corruption remains an ongoing issue. After all, the fifth plenum and its resulting major resolution are meant to spell out to party cadres and leadership alike that investigations and disciplinary measures are not only going to continue but will indeed increase as needed.

[According to the Global Times](https://www.globaltimes.cn/page/202610/1373268.shtml), an English-language paper under the umbrella of the official CCP mouthpiece, People’s Daily, the resolution paves the way to “reinforcing Xi Jinping’s core status and emphasizing strict ideological and political loyalty within the party.”

Ultimately, according to the communique, the CCP must rely upon self-governance and no other method of governing as the means of leading and developing China. As such, the plenum adopted the awkwardly-titled “Resolution on Certain Major Issues concerning Persevering with Full and Rigorous Party Self-Governance.”

“The experts stressed that the greatest threats to a ruling party can come from within, making sustained self-governance and strict internal discipline essential to avoiding the historical cycle of rise and decline,” the Global Times reported. Indeed, “self-governance” appears 31 times in the 10-page report.

In other words – and the communique doubles down on this point – China today by its very design and definition is a one-party state, and the CCP has no intentions of changing or reforming that condition. Quite the opposite.

This is hardly the first time that Chinese officialdom has publicly addressed the subject of governance of and in China. It is worth revisiting an April 14, 2022, report originally written by the Office of the Central National Security Commission. Titled “[Uphold the Predominant Position of Political Security](https://chinaopensourceobservatory.org/publications/chapter-six-persevere-in-placing-political-security-in-the-predominant-position/chapter-six-persevere-in-placing-political-security-in-the-predominant-position),” the report foretold many of th

title: 金與正發文 朝鮮否認策劃63億美元幣安黑客攻擊
summary: 圖像加註文字，金正恩妹妹金與正以朝鮮勞動黨中央官員身份發文反駁美方指控。 朝鮮（北韓）否認有關其策劃加密貨幣交易所幣安（Binance）遭創紀錄63億美元（420億元人民幣；2060億元新台幣）黑客攻擊的指控，稱有關指責是「荒唐無稽的謠言」。 朝鮮勞動黨中央委員會總務部長、最高領導人金正恩的妹妹金與正星期二（11月3日）表示，這些指控是美國損害朝鮮國際形象的又一次「不良企圖」。 美國聯邦調查局（FBI）、特勤局及網絡安全分析師表示，朝鮮策劃了這宗被形容為史上最大規模的黑客攻擊
content:
圖像加註文字，金正恩妹妹金與正以朝鮮勞動黨中央官員身份發文反駁美方指控。
朝鮮（北韓）否認有關其策劃加密貨幣交易所幣安（Binance）遭創紀錄63億美元（420億元人民幣；2060億元新台幣）黑客攻擊的指控，稱有關指責是「荒唐無稽的謠言」。
朝鮮勞動黨中央委員會總務部長、最高領導人金正恩的妹妹金與正星期二（11月3日）表示，這些指控是美國損害朝鮮國際形象的又一次「不良企圖」。
美國聯邦調查局（FBI）、特勤局及網絡安全分析師表示，朝鮮策劃了這宗被形容為史上最大規模的黑客攻擊。
平壤亦被指涉及多宗重大網絡攻擊事件，但一直否認有關指控。
Play video, "幣安63億美元黑客盜竊案 我們所知多少", 節目全長 0,44
音頻加註文字，BBC網絡安全記者喬·泰迪（Joe Tidy）解釋幣安黑客攻擊事件詳情。
幣安遭黑客攻擊：涉63億美元 或為史上最大規模 朝鮮黑客組織被指涉案2026年10月30日
朝鮮「精英」黑客組織是誰？為何成為幣安63億美元盜竊案的頭號嫌疑者？2026年10月31日
區塊鏈分析師及FBI表示，這次攻擊由國家支持的黑客組織「TraderTraitor」（交易叛徒）所主導。
FBI呼籲業界合作夥伴協助阻止涉及與該組織相關加密貨幣帳戶的交易。
金與正在聲明中表示，美國「再次發起慣用的挑釁，將之與朝鮮掛鈎」。
她表示：「美國誤導國際輿論，造成世界各地發生的網絡詐騙行為都是朝鮮所為的假象，分明是對朝鮮嚴重的政治挑釁。」
這宗事件是最新一宗被指與朝鮮有關的黑客攻擊。朝鮮一直被指依靠網絡犯罪為其經濟提供資金來源。
「TraderTraitor」組織亦被稱為「拉撒路集團」（Lazarus Group），該組織被指於2025年策劃了當時創紀錄、針對加密貨幣交易所 Bybit 的15億美元黑客攻擊。
包括新加坡拉惹勒南國際研究院（S Rajaratnam School of International Studies）在內的研究機構表示，平壤有系統地建立其網絡行動能力，從大學招募有潛力的學生，並將他們派往由朝鮮情報機構監督的黑客部門。
金與正表示：「堅決反對人類共同的財富——網絡空間的一切惡意行為⋯⋯是朝鮮民主主義人民共和國政府一貫的政策立場。」
Play video, "ByBit虛擬貨幣案：朝鮮黑客如何完成歷史上最大的劫案？", 節目全長 6,02
BBC已聯絡幣安置評。自黑客攻擊事件發生以來，這家加密貨幣巨頭的公開聲明主要集中於入侵事件的技術性質，以及其保護用戶的應對措施。

該公司一再表示，將承擔與這次攻擊有關的所有損失，並稱迄今已賠付約95%在這次入侵事件中被盜的資產。

content:
🩸❤️ Period Pixies Packing Party ❤️🩸, Sat, Nov 14, 2026, 10:00 AM | Meetup
Volunteer to assemble period packs with Lowcountry Period Pixies. SHL is supporting the Lowcountry Period Pixies packing party at the Hurd/St. Andrews Library – 1735 N. Woodmere Dr. in Charleston on Saturday, November 14th at 10 am. Join us and if you are able, bring a donation of individually wrapped pads, tampons, liners or wipes.
Why does this matter? 1 in 4 women and girls can't afford period products, which can't be purchased with SNAP or WIC benefits and are rarely donated to food banks. Many miss school or work because of it. These packs provide dignity — and prevent the health risks that come with using unsafe alternatives.
What will they be doing? Assembling period packs containing tampons, pads, liners, and wipes, which will be distributed to people in need across the tri-county area.
Can I bring something? Yes, please! The Pixies gratefully accept individually wrapped maxi pads, liners, and hygiene wipes. Bring some along if you wish — every item helps them assemble more packs.
Can't make it but want to help? 📦 Shop their Amazon Wish List — products ship directly to LPP. Items must be individually wrapped.
All are welcome. Bring a friend!

Space is limited to pre-registered Participants, with a back-up waitlist. Please kindly secure your ticket in advance at givetobliss.com.**
The goal of this intensive workshop is to give you the tools that you will need in order to be able to heal yourself by using what is easily available to you.
For you to derive the most benefit of this experience, I suggest that you find a partner that you will be able to work with outside this learning experience. If you are unable to identify such a person, we will do our best to hook you up with someone who lives nearby that might be able to become that partner. The reason that this is a very important is two-fold: When we finish this event you will probably be suffering from information overload, and it will be helpful, to have someone who listened and learned what you learned, so that you can rehash the information together for better understanding. The second and more important piece of the puzzle is that muscle testing (applied kinesiology) is an integral part of the learning process, and until you are sufficiently practiced to do self-muscle testing, you will need a partner. The body’s language is energy. Your body knows much more than you do, if you can speak your body’s language, you can learn all that your body knows that you are lacking. Muscle testing is that interface, it is the translator of your body’s language of energy. Most people have difficulty self-muscle testing because of major interferences that can be overcome if you know how to address them.
Within the pages of my book you will not only find some instructions on muscle testing, but you will also receive extensive lists of toxins and herbs as well as lists of the general causes of most illnesses.
Also, there is good information on multiple successful ways of activating your pineal gland, as well as a do-it-yourself shortcut to energy healing.
Is your body experiencing reversed polarity?
There is also a method that can fix that.
There are many successful ways to heal yourself, you just have to learn how to go about figuring out what is right for you, and get this……there is no one, not one single professional who knows better what your body needs than your own body, you just need to learn how to communicate with it!
You will also learn how frequencies can play a role in accelerated healing, and how you with just your computer or your phone can take advantage of this knowledge.
Crystals can play an important role in healing, if you understand how they heal and can then have the ability to choose the right crystals for your healing needs, you will be one step ahead of the game.
I have been practicing naturopathy for only 6 years, and every day I learn more, but I would like to share several healing stories that have been published in my book, for you to understand that these methodologies are real and they work.
I had Hashimoto’s. thyroid disease. I did the protocol Dr. Lang suggested and in three weeks was cutting back on my meds and in 4 weeks was off my thyroid medication. My blood work has shown no thyroid issues in several years since and I feel great! Dr. Lang is the real deal! Marcie P. South Carolina
I had a problem with High Blood Pressure for many years. I wanted a solution to get off of the medication, I was not comfortable taking it forever. My primary care doctor did not offer me other solutions. Dr. Lang recommended a supplement which worked wonders and almost immediately! My blood pressure began to quickly go down. I monitored my blood pressure every day, and when I reached the recommended level I was able to stop the medication. I have been stable for more than a year now. I feel wonderful. Cindy H. South Carolina
In August last year (2025) I had a melanoma removed; the results returned malignant level 4. I got the death stare from my Dr ... the sympathetic 'you're going to die' look. That night I researched until sun-up. As I reflect, I feel an angel was guiding as I found Dr. Lang’s Substack articles. I did the complete adult detox ... to the letter! And touchwood .... I am feeling great. Pauline B. Queensland, Australia
My husband had asthma for 40 years, there were inhalers all over the house, we followed Dr. Lang’s recommendations on her Substack article about asthma and now there are no inhalers needed at all, even after alcohol or a meal out. Nicola H. Brighton, England
I used to commute 130 miles each way through several major cities with having to deal with too many traffic jams. This, combined with normal stress, would push me over the edge and cause me to have type II herpes(cold sores outbreaks on my tongue which were extremely painful. I told Dr. Nikki about this and with the protocol that she gave me I have not had an outbreak in over 4 years. Kenny G Florida
Facilitator: Nikki Lang, [drnikkilang@gmail.com](mailto:drnikkilang@gmail.com)
If my husband were still alive (he passed February 6, 2026) we would be celebrating our 32nd wedding anniversary this past April, which is a big deal, since this is the third time around for both of us. Thirty some years ago after my divorce from my second husband but before I met prince charming, I was gallivanting off to Puerto Rico for some fun in the sun and was suffering my usually preflight anxiety. I was overcome by fear of flying but swore I would not let it interfere with my life.
While contemplating the flight with intense nervousness, a sudden calm came over me with the simultaneous thought that I was not going to die for a long time, because God had a plan for me and this was not my time to leave this world. And just like it took me three times to find the right soulmate, it took me a lifetime of family medical practice and then retirement to discover my true calling…….to deny much of what I was taught in medical school and to teach people how to heal themselves. These last five years have been a fascinating journey into naturopathy and how I learned to connect to my higher self in order to discover the healing methods that are perfect for each one of us.
Many integrative physicians arrived at their conclusions from experiencing an illness of their own and found that traditional allopathic medicine wasn’t the answer, but too often they fixate on the method that worked for them as the holy grail for others. We are all different and what is right for one person is not necessarily the answer for others. Muscle testing with discernment can put you in touch with your higher self and lead you to the methods of healing that are ideal for you.
It’s definitely a skill that needs to be honed, but once conquered you will discover how your God-given immune system holds all the answers. Healing from any illness is actually quite simple, the really hard part is overcoming all the impediments that stop us from being a thoughtful, discerning, responsible human being.
My hope is to be able to not only convey to you the skills to heal yourself, but to give you the confidence to do the same for others. After all, humans helping other humans is the goal of the universe, wouldn’t you say?

The latest research makes one thing clear: addressing climate change on a global scale requires us to rethink the built environment. Buildings contribute significantly to global warming—not only through how we heat and cool them, but through the materials we use to construct them.
Healthy, breathable buildings made from bio-based, plant-derived materials offer a powerful path toward a carbon-negative future—one that supports the health of both our planet and the people who inhabit it.
Come learn how April and the Root Down team are pioneering this movement across the Southeast and beyond through progressive architecture, hands-on building workshops, and educational classes that are transforming the way we think about—and build—the places we call home.
April Magill is a leading voice and pioneer in climate-smart, healthy, and sustainable building. She is the founder and owner of Charleston-based Root Down Designs, as well as the founder and executive director of a nonprofit advancing healthy, affordable housing for disadvantaged communities. As an educator and adjunct professor at the American College of the Building Arts, April teaches sustainable building practices and materials and has led numerous community workshops. She is also a sought-after national speaker on bio-based, carbon-negative building materials.

content:
ONSITE Beginner Belly Dancing w/ Karen Inella, Mon, Nov 2, 2026, 6:00 PM | Meetup
ONSITE Beginner Belly Dancing w/ Karen Inella
Hosted by karen innella .
6:00 – 7:00 pm (EST), on the 1st & 3rd Monday at bliss, 1007 Johnnie Dodds Blvd in Mt. Pleasant, in the Mat Class Mezzanine.
Explore exotic, sacred Belly dance at bliss, embrace the beauty of your unique shape, have fun, and meet other adventurous Participants who aren’t afraid to let it roll. Wear comfy clothes. We have plenty of hip shawls to share.
The first five minutes is generally a stretch and warm up of the muscles. Then we explore the way that the different parts of the body express itself with movement… the head, chest, arms, midsection, stomach, hips and of course the legs. Then we will combine these movements with mini combinations and practice simple choreography that everyone can do using authentic music from Egypt, Turkey and other middle eastern countries.
Many styles of Middle Eastern dance will be highlighted including Egyptian, Turkish, Folkloric and Moroccan. We will also introduce many props used in Middle Eastern dance including: the veil, zil, sword, cane and silk fans. This class is facilitated by a seasoned dancer and performer who lives to share her art.
**Facilitator: Karen Inella, shaktiselenebd@icloud.com**
Shakti Selene Shakti started belly dancing at the local YMCA in the South side of Chicago at the age of 16. Her teacher was Jasmine who was a muse of Eddie Kocheck. When she turned 18, she studied Egyptian Cabaret. Performances were made in the Chicago Art Institute where she attended college. She performed at private parties in Chicago Phoenix and Denver. She taught her skills wherever she danced. Her textile business led her to Turkey. Shakti fell in love with Istanbul. She eventually had a house and a dance studio close to the Blue Mosque. Her contacts led to many teaching opportunities, performances and development of a belly dance certification program from Istanbul Dreams. Through them she danced at corporate events, restaurants and taught different styles of belly dance.
Performances: Orient house Istanbul, Hilton Nile Cairo Egypt, Nile. Cruise ship On the Nile, Riads in Morocco, Singapore, taught a Tribal fusion seminar with Hafla, Samras Middle Eastern Dance event, Aegean Odessey Cruise Ship in the Greek islands, Eilot Israel evening local entertainment, Camel contracts, Cafe Paradiso, Taste of India
Dance companies: Ancient Echoes Belly Dance, Charleston Hula dancers, Allegro dance company, Charleston Black Sea dancers, Founding member of Palmetto Oasis
Teaching: Habibi Dance studio, Creative Spark, bliss Spiritual Co-op, Summerville YMCA
Styles of dance: Turkish Cabaret, Roman Havarsi Skirt, American Tribal, Fusion styles, Roman Havarsi, Bollywood, Khaligi, Saidi
Proficient in: Veil, Zil, Tambourine, Egyptian Wings, Silk and Feather Fans, Cane and Sticks.
Added interests: Celebrity chef specializing in Vegan Indian Food,

Nurnisa Kurban for Uyghur Academic Foundation
Uyghur Cultural Preservation and Survival Through Education
The Uyghur people have been persecuted and subjected to repressive Chinese government policies in their Indigenous homeland of East Turkestan for many years. It is estimated that up to three million Uyghurs have been interned, imprisoned, and enslaved in detention centers, prisons, and forced labor facilities throughout China since 2017.
In 2021, the Uyghur Tribunal found that China was committing genocide and other crimes against humanity against Uyghurs. In 2022, the United Nations also concluded that China was committing human rights violations against Uyghurs amounting to crimes against humanity. Countries including the United States, Canada, the Netherlands, Czech Republic, United Kingdom, Lithuania, Belgium, and France have all declared a genocide in East Turkestan. Despite these declarations of genocide and related reports by various human rights organizations, atrocities against Uyghurs continue today with very limited international recognition and accountability.
During this time of ongoing genocide and cultural erasure in their Indigenous homeland, Uyghurs of the diaspora are working to preserve their culture and identity as a matter of survival. Uyghur education has been eradicated by the Chinese State, Uyghur texts are forbidden and in danger of being eliminated, and the Uyghur language itself is prohibited.
Uyghur scholars, linguists, and other specialists in the diaspora worldwide serve on the Uyghur Language and Education Committee of the Uyghur Academy to preserve the work of Uyghur intellectuals who have been persecuted and forcibly disappeared. This work has been ongoing since 2009 and is continuing to expand.
The Committee has created standards-aligned K-5 textbooks, which include classic and contemperory Uyghur literature, poetry, historical texts, and biographies for Uyghur children to learn about their own culture and identity in their native language. The Committee is seeking funding to expand and revise the existing K-5 textbooks, create teacher’s edition textbooks for educators, and design supplemental resources. They also hope to develop Middle and High School textbooks and related supplemental resources. To effectively implement these educational materials, they would also like to provide training for teachers.
Please consider supporting this urgent work of the Uyghur Academic Foundation as a matter of cultural survival for future generations of the Uyghur people.

content:
Fundraiser by Craig De Meillon : Support Craig’s Mission to Aid Nepal Tibet Mudslide Victims
Craig’s campaign funds deployment, equipment, and communications for mudslide rescue work
Craig De Meillon is organizing this fundraiser.
My name is Craig De Meillon, and I am based in Miami, Florida. I work in safety and emergency management and am a trained firefighter and EMT with professional experience responding to disasters, emergencies, and humanitarian situations.
I am raising these funds as an independent volunteer to support my deployment to the areas affected by the recent mudslides and flooding in Nepal near the China border. I am not a family member or representative of anyone affected by the disaster, nor am I collecting these funds on behalf of a government agency or other organization. I am responding independently based on my emergency-response experience and my ability to bring useful communications and search equipment into the field.
The funds raised will be used primarily to cover the direct costs of my deployment and emergency-response work. This includes my airfare and ground transportation to and within the affected region, accommodation and essential field logistics, food and other necessary expenses while deployed, and emergency-response equipment and supplies.
A significant part of the funding will also be used for search and communications capabilities. This may include purchasing or renting drones that can be used to conduct aerial searches, assess inaccessible areas, locate people who may be stranded or missing, and help response teams understand conditions on the ground. Funds will also be used for satellite communications equipment and associated Starlink service costs so that I can maintain reliable communications in areas where local telecommunications infrastructure may be damaged, unavailable, or overloaded.
Where practical, I may purchase essential supplies locally rather than transporting them from the United States. This allows funds to be used more efficiently and can also support local businesses and responders.
The primary beneficiary of this fundraiser is me, Craig De Meillon, because the funds are being raised to cover the actual expenses I incur while independently deploying and carrying out this emergency-response work. The money is not being raised for personal profit or general living expenses. It is intended to offset the costs directly associated with the mission, including travel, equipment, communications, transportation, and necessary field expenses.
Once on the ground, I will coordinate as appropriate with local emergency responders, humanitarian organizations, community leaders, and other response personnel to determine where my skills, equipment, and communications capabilities can be most useful. My role and activities may change depending on the needs identified in the affected areas and the accessibility and safety of the region.
I will keep records of mission-related expenses and provide updates throughout the deployment so donors can understand how the funds are being used and what work is being carried out on the ground.
Thank you to everyone who contributes, shares this fundraiser, or supports the response in any way. Every contribution helps make it possible for me to get the equipment, communications, and resources needed to reach affected areas and assist where I can. Flood

content:
Fundraiser by Dominic Urso : Help Bhujung Rebuild After the Tibet-Nepal Flood
Bhujung’s fund covers urgent food, shelter, and essentials lost in the recent Syabru Besi flood
Dominic Urso is organizing this fundraiser.
Dominic and Kayla are raising funds for Bhujung Tamang, a friend they met while traveling in Nepal before/after the Langtang trek. During that trip, Dominic and Kayla stayed with Bhujung for a few days in his village of Syabru Besi. Bhujung welcomed them with kindness and gave them a truly special local experience they have never forgotten. Now, after a devastating flood destroyed Syabru Besi, Bhujung is facing an unimaginable loss. His home and hotel were destroyed, many of his friends were killed or are missing, and he lost all of his possessions in the disaster. It is estimated that Syabru Besi still has 1300 people missing.
Dominic and Kayla met Bhujung by chance while starting their 7 day hike up the Langtang Valley, one of Nepal's premier hiking destinations. They were looking for a place to stay and found the only hotel in the Old Village of Syabru Besi. Upon getting to know Bhujung, Dominic and Kayla discovered that they were the first guests Bhujung had had in almost 3 years because he was taking care of his late mother's declining health. As a token of gratitude and friendship, Bhujung gifted Dominic and Kayla a hand stitched bag his mother made pictured above.
This fundraiser is meant to provide direct relief to Bhujung as he begins the long process of recovering and rebuilding after this tragedy. The money raised will go directly to him to help support his immediate needs (food, housing, etc.) and give him a foundation to move forward after losing so much. Dominic and Kayla are asking for donations of any amount to help Bhujung through this heartbreaking time. If you are able to give, thank you for showing compassion and support to someone who once showed such generosity to travelers far from home. Please consider donating and sharing this fundraiser to help Bhujung rebuild his life.

content:
Fundraiser by Tarra Subhar Massallo : Immediate aid for families affected by the Nepal-Tibet Flood
This fund provides direct aid for shelter, food, and essentials to Nepal-Tibet families
Tarra Subhar Massallo is organizing this fundraiser.
After fleeing from the Chinese annexation of Tibet, many Kyirong Tibetan families crossed into Nepal believing their exile would be temporary. It was not. Syabrubesi and the Trishuli valley had become their home instead- a place where hundreds of families had to rebuild from nothing, including my grandparents. Like many Tibetan refugees, they eventually moved on to build new lives in India. However, not everyone left. Some of their family stayed behind in Syabrubesi and the Trishuli valley, carrying on the roots left behind by previous generations.
On August 26, 2026, a glacier collapse high in the Langtang Himal sent a wall of water and debris surging down the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli Bazaar: the towns where that branch of our family stayed and built their lives after losing everything once before. Four households in our family were directly affected:
Our cousin Dawa Dakpa (confirmed deceased) leaves behind a wife and two young children.
Aku Jangchup, his wife, and child (confirmed deceased)
Nama Nangsa Ghongma's family and relatives (missing)
Nama Karmo Subhar's family and relatives (missing)
Now, our families face rebuilding once again, with roads and homes submerged in mud. 100% of every contribution will go directly to these impacted families and the wider flood-affected communities as they recover together. The funds will be spent on various essentials based on each family's needs (including, but not limited to: temporary shelter, food, emergency medical care, and transportation costs). We invite you to help write the next chapter of this story. Please help support this fundraiser in any way that you can.
My name is Tarra Subhar Massallo. I am the granddaughter of Tibetan refugees who fled from Kyirong during the 1959 Chinese annexation of Tibet, and the daughter of a Tibetan immigrant mother who moved from India to the United States with her family in search of a better life. Growing up in a mixed household, I am surrounded by the importance of my many cultures and giving back to my respective communities.

The Indian Association of Sacramento (IAS) based in Sacramento , California, USA has a long-standing commitment to helping families in need. We have also responded to natural disasters, including supporting victims of the 2025 Nepal earthquake.
Today, we ask you to stand with flood-affected families. Please give what you can—every contribution matters, and even a small donation can help provide vital supplies and support.
Together, we can bring relief to families who have lost so much.

content:
Fundraiser by Rinzin Alling : Help Nepal-Tibet Border Relief
This relief fund directs aid to Nepal border victims via trusted local networks and NGOs
Rinzin Alling is organizing this fundraiser.
Momo Crawlers, we’re asking for your help.
The disaster at the Nepal-Tibet border has left thousands displaced from their homes, and the full scope of the crisis is still being realized. Many Momo Crawl vendors and volunteers remain concerned for loved ones who are still missing.
Through friends and family, we’ve established contact with mutual aid networks on the ground in Nepal. They are also providing us with live updates on the aid groups they’re seeing, what those groups are accomplishing, and where additional support is most needed.
Our plan is to allocate funds according to the feedback we receive from our contacts in Nepal. In addition to mutual aid groups and NGOs, we anticipate directing a significant portion of proceeds to the Nepali government’s Prime Minister Disaster Relief Fund. This fund accepts digital payments, and we encourage you to donate directly if you prefer: https://pmdrf.nchl.com.np
We established this GoFundMe primarily for ease of use and to help us track the impact of the Momo Crawl community. We expect to keep the drive active until Momo Crawl on September 13th, 2026, but donations received now will be allocated to relief efforts on a rolling basis. We will share updates about the use of funds as information becomes available.

Russia-China strategic partnership reaches unprecedented level — defense minister
It is based on personal contacts between Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping, Andrey Belousov emphasized
MOSCOW, November 3. /TASS/. The strategic partnership between Russia and China is at an unprecedented high level, Russian Defense Minister Andrey Belousov said during talks with Chinese Central Military Commission Vice Chairman Colonel General Zhang Shengmin.
"The strategic partnership between our countries has reached an unprecedented high level. It is based on personal contacts between Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping," the top defense official emphasized.
Belousov also congratulated Zhang Shengmin on his election as a member of the Political Bureau of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) Central Committee.
For his part, the senior Chinese defense official noted that the leaders of Russia and China have met many times this year. "They have charted new strategic directions for the development of China-Russia relations. And our meeting today is a practical step toward implementing the important agreements reached by our heads of state," Zhang Shengmin noted.
He also expressed confidence in further developing friendship and cooperation between China's and Russia's armed forces.

Tainan, Taiwan – Silver-hulled sea drones skim across the water as part of an exhibition in Taiwan where local and foreign companies are competing for a share of surging government investment in uncrewed vehicles to deter China.
As Chinese military pressure increases, Taiwan is pouring billions of dollars into aerial and sea drones, which have been widely used in Russia’s war in Ukraine and in the Strait of Hormuz with devastating effect.
Taiwan’s military has said it wants to acquire more than 1,400 coastal surveillance and reconnaissance drones, over 200,000 coastal attack drones and 1,320 one-way attack uncrewed surface vessels (USVs).

content:
国际刑事法院主席敦促联合国成员国就美国制裁为法院辩护 - 日本时报
国际刑事法院主席敦促联合国成员捍卫法院免受美国制裁
国际刑事法院院长 Tomoko Akane 在 10 月份的一段视频中批评美国对她和她的机构的制裁。 |集集
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接
国际刑事法院（ICC）院长茜智子呼吁所有联合国成员国采取“具体行动”，反对美国对法院施加的越来越大的压力，并警告说，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府实施的制裁威胁到国际正义和法治。
茜于 8 月份成为美国制裁的个人目标，导致她无法进入美国，并于周一通过预先录制的视频向纽约联合国大会提交了年度报告。
这是自 COVID-19 大流行以来国际刑事法院主席首次在大会上远程讲话。
特朗普政府上月初加大了针对该法院的打击力度，此前针对涉及美国及其盟国（包括以色列）的调查而针对个别法官和检察官，对该机构本身实施了前所未有的制裁。
茜周一再次谴责这些措施企图妨碍司法公正和破坏司法独立，并指出该法院 18 名法官中有 9 人目前受到美国制裁。
她说：“法院将继续以法律和证据为基础，独立、公正地充分履行职责，为无数严重犯罪受害者着想。”
茜还敦促成员国合作执行尚未执行的逮捕令，包括向俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京和以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡发出的逮捕令。
国际刑事法院成立于 2002 年，在国家当局无法或不愿意调查和起诉种族灭绝罪、战争罪和反人类罪时负责调查和起诉。美国不是该法院的成员。
欧盟和其他国家的代表也在周一的会议上表达了对国际刑事法院的强烈支持。
此次上诉之际，日本作为国际法院的主要财政捐助国和基于规则的国际秩序的坚定倡导者，因华盛顿不断升级的压力而面临外交困境。
日本首相高市早苗一直在努力平衡东京对国际法院的支持与特朗普领导下的美国安全联盟。尽管她称制裁与日本的立场不相容，并承诺继续支持国际刑事法院，但她没有直接谴责华盛顿的行为。
“法院不能孤立无援。它的命运现在也掌握在创建它的国家手中，”茜说。
“这不仅仅是为了捍卫一个机构，而是为了维护以法治为基础的国际秩序。”

International Criminal Court President Tomoko Akane speaks in a video in October, criticizing U.S. sanctions against her and her institution. | JIJI
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
International Criminal Court (ICC) President Tomoko Akane has called on all United Nations member states to take “concrete action” against mounting U.S. pressure on the court, warning that sanctions imposed by U.S. President Donald Trump’s administration threaten international justice and the rule of law.
Akane delivered her annual report to the U.N. General Assembly in New York on Monday via prerecorded video after being personally targeted by U.S. sanctions in August that have made her unable to enter the United States.
It was the first time since the COVID-19 pandemic that an ICC president had addressed the assembly remotely.
The Trump administration escalated its campaign against the court early last month, imposing unprecedented sanctions on the institution itself after previously targeting individual judges and prosecutors over investigations involving the United States and its allies, including Israel.
Akane on Monday again condemned the measures as an attempt to obstruct justice and undermine judicial independence, noting that nine of the court’s 18 judges are now under U.S. sanctions.
“The court will continue to fully discharge its mandate, with independence and impartiality, acting only on the basis of the law and the evidence, for the sake of the countless victims of grave crimes,” she said.
Akane also urged member states to cooperate in executing outstanding arrest warrants, including those issued for Russian President Vladimir Putin and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
Established in 2002, the ICC investigates and prosecutes genocide, war crimes and crimes against humanity when national authorities are unable or unwilling to do so. The United States is not a member of the court.
Representatives of the European Union and other countries also voiced strong support for the ICC during Monday’s session.
The appeal comes as Japan, a major financial contributor to the court and a staunch advocate of the rules-based international order, faces a diplomatic dilemma over Washington’s escalating pressure.
Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi has struggled to balance Tokyo’s support for the court with its security alliance with the United States under Trump. Although she has described the sanctions as incompatible with Japan’s position and pledged continued support for the ICC, she has stopped short of directly condemning Washington’s actions.
“The court cannot stand alone. Its fate now rests also in the hands of the states that created it,” Akane said.
“This is not just about defending a single institution, but about safeguarding the international order grounded upon the rule of law.”

随着年底最后期限的临近，日本认真对待国防开支的增加
六月，在静冈县御殿场市的东富士训练场，富士山附近的年度训练中，一辆陆上自卫队 16 型机动战车正在开火。 |路透社

随着 2026 年即将过去，修订三项关键安全文件的年底最后期限迫在眉睫，日本政策制定者正在认真考虑大规模增加国防开支的计划。
据报道，日本政府和执政联盟正在考虑在未来五年内将国防开支增加近一倍，因为日本希望在东京所说的地区安全环境日益严峻的情况下进一步加强该国的军事能力。
从 2027 年 4 月开始的五年计划中，支出可能会增加至 80 万亿日元（5,080 亿美元），大约是 2023 财年开始的当前计划分配的约 43 万亿日元的 1.8 倍。

As 2026 winds down and a year-end deadline for revisions to three key security documents looms, Japanese policymakers are getting serious about plans for a massive defense spending hike.
The government and ruling coalition are reportedly considering nearly doubling defense spending over the next five years as Japan looks to further strengthen the country’s military capabilities amid what Tokyo says is an increasingly fraught regional security environment.
One plan for the five years from April 2027 could see spending rise to as much as ¥80 trillion ($508 billion), up about 1.8 times the roughly ¥43 trillion allocated under the current plan that began in fiscal 2023.

War widens in the Black Sea in a test of NATO red lines
A Liberian-flagged container ship Contship Jet in the Black Sea off Bulgaria on Oct. 28. The ship sank after being hit by naval drones, according to the Bulgarian government, while en route from Haifa in Israel to Constanta in Romania. | French Armed Forces / via REUTERS

LONDON/BUCHAREST – After seven strikes on cargo ships near NATO members Romania and Bulgaria last month, the U.S.-led military alliance said it would deploy maritime patrol aircraft, radars and drones to bolster its eastern flank in the Black Sea.
Three days later, on Oct. 23, another ship was struck just outside Romanian waters. And last week a Greek container ship was sunk by naval drones in Bulgaria’s exclusive economic zone.
Unabating attacks show how the escalating maritime war between Russia and Ukraine is expanding into a major challenge for NATO in the Black Sea that has left littoral member states such as Romania and Bulgaria exposed.

日本和越南考虑签署新协议以防止犯罪 - 日本时报
日本和越南考虑签署新协议以防止犯罪
越南总理高市早苗与越南共产党总书记苏林五月在河内举行会谈。 |集集
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接
消息人士称，日本和越南政府正在考虑缔结一项新协议，允许两国相互提供在各自国家被捕或拘留的对方国民的信息。
该计划的目的是在越南公民在日本犯罪数量增加的情况下加强威慑。
日本政府消息人士称，在下周一的会议上，日本首相高市早苗和越南共产党总书记、东南亚国家主席苏林预计将确认缔结新协议的计划。越南领导人将于周日开始对日本进行为期四天的访问。
两国领导人5月在河内会晤时同意加强领事事务合作。
根据《维也纳领事关系公约》，向其本国报告外国人被逮捕或拘留的情况原则上需要征得本人同意。
消息人士称，日本和越南正在考虑根据设想的协议，允许在未经被捕或拘留个人同意的情况下进行此类报道。
一名日本官员表示：“由于越南拥有强大的公安机关，迅速报告逮捕或拘留事件将是一个重大威慑。”
虽然诸如此类报告的事件类型等细节将在未来讨论，但由于涉及人权，该协议至少需要两三年才能生效。
据国家警察厅称，2025年，警方对涉及越南公民（不包括日本永久居民）的案件采取了10,773起案件，比上一年增加约11%。这一数字占所有涉外案件的40%以上。
迄今为止，日本已与美国、英国、中国和前苏联签署了类似的报告协定或条约。
日苏领事条约及相关议定书规定，被逮捕或拘留者有权在逮捕或拘留后三天内寻求报告，并规定被逮捕或拘留者与领事在四天内会面的权利。
根据条约和议定书，日本政府要求尽早与日本最北部北海道县《北海道新闻》的一名日本记者进行领事会面，这名记者于10月13日因涉嫌间谍活动被俄罗斯当局拘留。

Japan and Vietnam consider new pact to prevent crimes - The Japan Times
Japan and Vietnam consider new pact to prevent crimes
Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi and Communist Party of Vietnam General Secretary To Lam meet for talks in Hanoi in May. | JIJI
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
The Japanese and Vietnamese governments are considering concluding a new pact allowing them to mutually provide information on each other’s nationals arrested or detained in their own countries, sources have said.
The planned pact is aimed at strengthening deterrence amid an increase in the number of crimes committed by Vietnamese nationals in Japan.
During their meeting on Monday next week, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi and Communist Party of Vietnam General Secretary To Lam, also president of the Southeast Asian nation, are expected to confirm the plan to conclude the new pact, Japanese government sources said. The Vietnamese leader is slated to visit Japan for four days from Sunday.
When they met in Hanoi in May, the two leaders agreed to strengthen cooperation over consular affairs.
Under the Vienna Convention on Consular Relations, reporting the arrest or detention of a foreigner to his or her home country requires the consent of the individual in principle.
Japan and Vietnam are considering allowing such reporting without the consent of arrested or detained individuals under the envisaged pact, according to the sources.
“As Vietnam has strong public security authorities, reporting the arrest or detention swiftly will be a major deterrent,” a Japanese official said.
While details, such as the types of incidents subject to such reporting, will be discussed in the future, it will take at least two or three years before the pact takes effects because it concerns human rights.
According to the National Police Agency, police took action against 10,773 cases involving Vietnamese nationals, excluding permanent residents in Japan, in 2025, up about 11% from the preceding year. The figure accounted for more than 40% all such cases involving foreigners.
Japan has so far signed a similar reporting pact or treaty with the United States, Britain China and the former Soviet Union.
The Japan-Soviet consular affairs treaty and related protocols stipulate the right to seek reporting within three days of arrest or detention and meetings between arrested or detained individuals and consuls within four days.
Based on the treaty and protocols, the Japanese government requested an early consular meeting for a Japanese reporter for the Hokkaido Shimbun, a daily newspaper in the northernmost Japan prefecture of Hokkaido, who was detained by Russian authorities on Oct. 13 on suspicion of espionage.

黄之锋将于 11 月 5 日在香港第二次国家安全审判中被判刑。他已经承认共谋指控。
检察官称，黄、罗冠聪和其他人要求外国团体扰乱香港和中国的法律或政策。这项指控可能会导致终身监禁。
黄已经因颠覆罪被判入狱近五年。他的律师希望判刑三到十年，并称他已经在监狱里度过了大约六年。
香港 - 据司法机构网站称，香港法院将于 11 月 5 日对著名活动家黄之锋进行第二次国家安全审判，他可能被判处终身监禁。
黄因颠覆罪已被判近五年监禁，预计将于 2027 年初获释，他于 9 月承认了共谋指控。
这位 30 岁的前学生领袖是该市现已被镇压的民主运动中最知名的面孔之一。
他于 2025 年根据北京对香港实施的国家安全法受到指控，此举遭到了人权组织的谴责。
香港司法机构网站11月3日显示，量刑听证会定于11月5日举行。
黄在十多年前的广泛抗议活动中崭露头角，后来参与了 2019 年的大型集会，引发了国家安全法的实施。

黄的朋友在 2026 年初告诉法新社，这位活动人士在拘留期间通过锻炼、弹吉他和学习大学课程仍然“精力充沛”。
如果发现“性质严重”，外国勾结罪可能会被判处无期徒刑。
黄的律师主张将刑期缩短为 3 至 10 年，并指出黄已经因各种罪行入狱约六年。法新社

Hong Kong to sentence activist Joshua Wong on Nov 5

Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong (seen here in September 2020) pleaded guilty to collusion charges in September.
Published Nov 03, 2026, 01:15 PM
Updated Nov 03, 2026, 01:15 PM
Joshua Wong will be sentenced in Hong Kong on 5 November in a second national security trial. He has already pleaded guilty to collusion charges.
Prosecutors say Wong, Nathan Law and others asked foreign groups to disrupt Hong Kong and China laws or policies. The charge can bring life in prison.
Wong is already serving nearly five years for subversion. His lawyer wants three to 10 years, saying he has already spent about six years in prison.
HONG KONG - A Hong Kong court will sentence prominent activist Joshua Wong on Nov 5, according to the judiciary’s website, in a second national security trial that could see him jailed for life.
Wong, who is already serving a nearly five-year jail term for subversion and was due for release in early 2027, pleaded guilty to the collusion charges in September.
The 30-year-old former student leader is one of the most recognisable faces of the city’s now-quashed democracy movement.
He was charged in 2025 under a national security law imposed on Hong Kong by Beijing, in a move condemned by rights groups.
The Hong Kong judiciary website showed on Nov 3 that a sentencing hearing was scheduled for Nov 5.
Wong sprang to prominence during widespread protests more than a decade ago, and was later involved in huge rallies in 2019 that triggered the imposition of the national security law.
Prosecutors said Wong, self-exiled activist Nathan Law and others asked foreign entities to seriously disrupt the formulation and implementation of laws or policies in Hong Kong and China.
Wong’s friends told AFP earlier in 2026 that the activist remained “energetic” while in detention by working out, playing the guitar and studying university courses.
The offence of foreign collusion may be punishable by life imprisonment if found to be of a “serious nature”.
Wong’s lawyer has argued for a shorter sentence of three to 10 years, noting that Wong has already spent around six years in prison for various offences. AFP

content:
如果黑客能夠控制超市的冷凍櫃，其他科技設備又有多脆弱？ - BBC News 中文
Author, 希奧娜·麥卡勒姆（Shiona McCallum）
歐洲多地超市近日遭遇一起疑似網絡攻擊，影響其冷藏櫃和冷凍櫃，並引發外界對互聯網連接硬件漏洞的憂慮。這些硬件涵蓋工業機械，以至日常家用電器。
連接互聯網的智能設備可以包括冰箱、中央供暖系統，甚至洗衣機。
雖然這類設備因此更容易被遠程控制，但理論上，任何接入網絡的設備都有可能被惡意行為者利用。
然而，這並不意味著黑客能輕易取得控制權，而且大型品牌通常會投入大量資源，確保其產品的安全性。
過去曾在部分設備中發現漏洞。2015年，研究人員展示了三星（Samsung）智能冰箱中的一項漏洞，如何讓他們攔截互聯網流量。
不過，目前沒有證據顯示，在11月針對超市發動的網絡攻擊中，家用電器成為了攻擊目標。
英國國家網絡安全中心（NCSC）前行政總裁西亞蘭·馬丁（Ciaran Martin）表示，製造商需要採取更多措施，提升連網設備的安全性。
他說：「我們需要對大型科技公司提出更多要求，讓它們從一開始就為我們提供更安全的設備和產品。」
台灣新北市長選戰：「政二代」蘇巧慧對決「專業副手」李四川，誰能拿下藍綠關鍵一城？
他建議消費者保持設備更新，並在可行情況下啟用多重身份驗證。
自2024年4月起，英國法律已要求部分消費級智能設備製造商符合最低網絡安全標準，包括密碼管理和安全更新方面的要求。
英國國家網絡安全中心表示，正與國際夥伴及業界合作，以了解這些超市事件的情況，但目前並未發現對英國造成任何影響。
不過，英國網絡防禦（UK Cyber Defence）的研究人員已識別出超過800個與英國零售商相關的製冷及樓宇控制系統介面，可透過公共互聯網存取。
這並不一定意味著它們能夠被入侵，但可能使其暴露於利用弱密碼或軟件漏洞的攻擊者面前。
在早前超市遭受網絡攻擊後，政府已與食品零售業高層舉行會談，討論網絡韌性問題。
英國零售聯盟（British Retail Consortium）行政總裁海倫·狄金森（Helen Dickinson）表示，網絡安全事件是零售商的一大憂慮，各企業正與國家網絡安全中心合作，共享情報並強化防禦能力。
2025年5月，英國超市馬莎百貨（M&S）和合作社集團（Co-op）遭勒索軟件黑客攻擊時，兩家零售商一度難以用新鮮貨品補充部分門店貨架。
網絡安全公司 SentinelOne 研究員湯姆·黑格爾（Tom Hegel）表示，零售商必須更清楚界定責任歸屬。
他說：「零售商需要回答的問題是，誰負責這些設備的安全，而不只是誰負責維修它們。」
他表示，互聯網連接能使日常科技產品更加方便，但安全措施必須同步跟上。
他說：「一旦攻擊者能夠操控這些控制系統，像除霜這樣的正常功能也會變成干擾工具。」
他說：「改變一項設定就可能摧毀實體庫存，而不只是干擾電腦系統。」
在家庭以外，連網技術亦被用於遠程管理工業機械和車輛。
網絡安全專家肯·芒羅（Ken Munro）提到2015年的一次演示，研究人員透過一輛Jeep汽車連接互聯網的娛樂系統進行遠程入侵，促使業界加強車輛安全措施。
他說：「幸運的是，汽車行業已意識到這個問題，並作出了修復。」
流動通訊連接也被廣泛用於監察發電廠及供水網絡中的設備，讓工程師能夠遠程管理系統。
芒羅表示，英國公共事業機構在保護這些連接方面普遍做得不錯，但世界各地的標準並不一致。
他最擔心的是規模較小、資金不足的公用事業公司，這些公司可能仍依賴較舊且存在漏洞的設備。
Zscaler 網絡安全專家奧利維耶·達洛伊（Olivier Daloy）表示，如果缺乏適當的保護措施，任何接入互聯網的「工廠或設備」，從汽車製造商到電力或交通基礎設施，都可能面臨類似風險。
本文原以英文撰寫，我們使用了人工智能協助翻譯，並由BBC記者在發佈前進行審核。了解更多關於我們如何使用人工智能的資訊。

content:
《蘋果日報》前社長張劍虹提早獲釋，赴深圳交流、向官媒稱「好懊悔」 - BBC News 中文
香港傳媒報導，前壹傳媒行政總裁、《蘋果日報》前社長張劍虹，已提早獲釋。他參加懲教署舉辦的深圳參觀活動，並接受中國官媒訪問表示對自己的罪行「好懊悔」，現在對中國人身分「十分驕傲」。
他因違反《香港國安法》的「串謀勾結外國勢力」，被判監6年9個月，原定2028年3月才刑滿出獄。香港懲教署回覆BBC中文查詢時，未有確認張劍虹等人是否已獲釋；BBC中文致電張劍虹手機，無人接聽。
除了張劍虹，據報至少還有3名因《香港國安法》入獄的人士，亦已提早獲釋。
分析人士向BBC中文指出，國安案件的被定罪者要提早獲釋，或需主動配合政府，在親官方媒體認錯。而官方交流團，除了有宣傳效果，亦是向釋囚展示一種會被監視的「威懾作用」。
這次事件也讓外界關注，壹傳媒創辦人黎智英能否同獲假釋機會。
張劍虹提早獲釋消息曝光，源於11月1日中國官媒鳳凰衛視一則報導。
報導中，張劍虹以「更生人士」身分參加懲教署的深圳體驗團，獲安排參觀抗戰史迹及科企。他身穿紅衣受訪表示，「自己作為中國人，能夠體驗到國家這麼強大，科技發展這麼好，也是十分驕傲」。
翌日，鳳凰衛視刊登更詳細的訪問片段，並標註張劍虹是「前壹傳媒行政總裁」，他在訪問中表示，自己是「主動報名」參加懲教署活動，又對過往所犯的罪行「好懊悔」，「希望藉這個機會重新認識祖國發展、融入社會，有個更生機會」。
台灣新北市長選戰：「政二代」蘇巧慧對決「專業副手」李四川，誰能拿下藍綠關鍵一城？
資料顯示，鳳凰衛視的大股東是央企紫荊文化集團，該集團由中國財政部全資控股。
香港媒體《明報》引述贊助該團的「紙紮大王」夏中建指，該考察團給服刑完畢的人了解內地發展，形容張劍虹出入內地過關順利，反而離境香港時較緊張，被邀請「入房」問幾句。
64歲的張劍虹在業界素有「沙膽虹」之稱。他1983年畢業於中文大學新聞系，曾在《明報》、《經濟日報》等工作，1991年入職壹傳媒，1994年升至《壹週刊》總編輯一職，於2000年起到台灣協助發展《壹週刊》。他先後擔任《蘋果日報》總編輯、副社長、社長等高層職位，並於2018年升為壹傳媒行政總裁。
他在2021年6月17日被捕，涉及「串謀勾結外國勢力」及「串謀發布煽動刊物」罪。經歷長期還押和156日審訊後，香港高等法院在今年2月9日判刑6年9個月。
圖像加註文字，張劍虹在2021年6月17日被捕，曾經歷長期還押和156日審訊，被判監6年9個月。
綜合香港傳媒報導，近期至少有4名因《國安法》被判監的人提早獲釋，其中3位是壹傳媒國安案件的被告，包括張劍虹、「香港故事」成員李宇軒和律師助理陳梓華，3人均曾擔任從犯證人，在審訊時協助控方。
另外一位提早獲釋是香港首宗《國安法》案件被告唐英傑，他在2020年7月1日駕駛插有「光復香港 時代革命」旗幟電單車撞向警員防線，翌年被裁定煽動他人分裂國家罪及恐怖活動罪成，判刑9年。原本預計在2029年7月出獄，現時提早兩年獲釋。
香港本地媒體《經濟日報》11月3日引述消息指，壹傳媒國安案另外2名從犯證人也有機會提早獲釋，即前《蘋果日報》副社長陳沛敏、社論主筆楊清奇。2人原本預計在2028年7月、10月分別刑滿。
BBC中文向香港懲教署查詢，張劍虹等4人是否已獲釋，陳沛敏、楊清奇是否有機會提早獲釋。署方回覆稱，不會就個別個案作出評論。而張劍虹參加的交流團為「伴『理』前行」計劃的重點項目之一，旨在通過有系統及多元化的活動，加強更生人士的國家安全意識，培養守法精神及責任感。
在壹傳媒國安案件中，沒有擔任從犯證人的《蘋果》前總編輯羅偉光、前執行總編輯林文宗、前英文版執行總編輯馮偉光被判囚10年。如果沒有假釋，最快2031年中才出獄。
Play video, "《蘋果日報》黎智英國安罪行全數成立 前下屬憶往昔：不枉此生", 節目全長 20,04
目前已知首位提早獲釋的國安案定罪者，是「47人案」的從犯證人趙家賢，他被判囚七年，提早兩年在2025年10月28日獲釋。
趙家賢與張劍虹一樣，在獲釋後接受電視專訪。2025年12月《無綫新聞》播出專訪中，他感恩獲懲教署署長等信納有悔過的決心。
「一判（刑）之後就即時『開Turbo（引擎）』，看很多的書，關於國家發展。透過家人送來國務院發布的國家政策文件、習主席有關『一帶一路』發言、重要講話。」
被指提早獲釋的唐英傑至少四度在鏡頭前受訪，包括2023年12月香港警察與無綫電視合製的節目《有法安國》、2024年4月《星島頭條》的訪問、2025年4月懲教署推出國安微電影《暫借的榮耀》、2026年6月由特區政府製作節目《國安檔案解密》。
在《國安檔案解密》中，主持人陳啟泰形容唐英傑已洗心革面，更擔任升旗手，思想有重大轉變。拍攝時仍在囚的唐英傑以背面和變聲出鏡，他表示自己被一些「叫人衝、自己鬆」的人誤導。
香港《監獄規則》列明，服刑中囚犯可因行為表現良好而獲減刑，不得超逾實際刑期的三分之一，但在《基本法》23條立法後，收緊國安囚犯提早獲釋門檻，須獲懲教署長信納不會不利於國安才可提早減刑釋放。
在囚支援平台「候鳥」成員尤思聰向BBC中文表示，從現有例子可見，在標誌性的國安案件，被定罪者要提早獲釋，或需「主動配合」政府，展示自己在思想上、精神上臣服於政府，「公開在親官方媒體公開認錯，甚至拍宣傳片，可能要做一種模範的更生人士」。
尤思聰指出，在現行制度下，國安案件提早獲釋的人，需在假釋期間要遵守懲教署的監管令。他觀察到，期間懲教署會邀請這些釋囚參加文化交流活動，「都是有一種宣傳效果，以及對囚犯本人是一種持續的威懾力，更加明白到出獄後，政府仍會一直監視你。」
Play video, "黎智英國安法案遭判20年 《蘋果》員工判囚6年9個月至10年", 節目全長 6,32
壹傳媒國安案多位被定罪者提早獲釋，外界關注因為串謀勾結外國勢力及發布煽動刊物，被判刑20年的壹傳媒創辦人黎智英情況。
黎智英在沒有減刑下，預計最快要2040年才獲釋，即92歲出獄。
今年5月，美國總統特朗普訪華期間，曾點名提及黎智英，事後形容中方反應「並不正面」，稱這是「棘手的事情」。
中國外交部發言人郭嘉昆今年5月被問釋放黎智英，郭嘉昆表示，黎智英是反中亂港事件的主要策劃者和參與者。香港事務屬於中國內政，中國中央政府堅定支持香港司法機關依法履職盡責。
香港本地媒體《經濟日報》11月3日引述不具名的建制派人士表示，提早獲釋方式不適用於黎智英，認為僅有一個情況可提早獲釋，「除非驗出有極重症惡疾，而且命不久矣！」

IEA注意到俄罗斯对中国的天然气供应增长
国际能源署表示，中国的管道天然气进口总量将与年度持平，但由于乌兹别克斯坦的运输中断，中亚的交付量将下降
莫斯科，11 月 3 日。/塔斯社/。国际能源署（IEA）在报告中表示，俄罗斯通过西伯利亚力量天然气管道小幅增加了对中国的天然气供应。
IEA表示：“据了解，俄罗斯通过西伯利亚力量管道系统向中国出口的天然气与去年的水平相比略有增加。”
该机构表示，中国的管道天然气进口总量将与年度保持持平，但由于乌兹别克斯坦的运输中断，中亚的交付量将下降。
IEA 强调：“俄罗斯强劲的管道供应将足以抵消这些较低的交付量。远东管道预计将于 2027 年 1 月开始运营，产能为 10 bcm/年，尽管实际管道流量将通过管道系统逐渐增加。”
俄罗斯天然气工业股份公司早些时候表示，11月1日更新了西伯利亚力量天然气管道向中国的日供气记录。

IEA notes growth of Russian gas supplies to China
Total pipe gas imports by China will remain flat in annual terms but deliveries from Central Asia will decline due to disruptions in transportation from Uzbekistan, the International Energy Agency said
MOSCOW, November 3. /TASS/. Russia slightly increased natural gas supplies to China over the Power of Siberia gas pipeline, the International Energy Agency (IEA) said in its report.
"Russia’s gas exports to China via the Power of Siberia pipeline system are understood to have marginally increased compared with last year’s levels," the IEA said.
Total pipe gas imports by China will remain flat in annual terms but deliveries from Central Asia will decline due to disruptions in transportation from Uzbekistan, the agency said.
"These lower deliveries would be more than offset by stronger pipeline supplies from Russia. The Far East pipeline is expected to start operations in January 2027 with a capacity of 10 bcm/yr, although actual pipeline flows would ramp up gradually through the pipeline system," the IEA stressed.
Russian gas holding Gazprom said earlier that it updated the record of daily gas supplies to China over the Power of Siberia gas pipeline on November 1.

title: Synology NAS Devices Targeted in Ransomware Attacks Exploiting Patched DSM Flaw

summary: Synology NAS 设备成为勒索软件攻击的目标，利用已修补的 DSM 漏洞 Synology NAS 设备成为勒索软件攻击的目标，利用已修补的 DSM 漏洞 Ravie Lakshmananp2026 年 11 月 3 日勒索软件/网络攻击 Synology 敦促客户在勒索软件攻击后更新为其网络附加存储 (NAS) 设备供电的 DiskStation Manager (DSM) 软件。这家台湾供应商表示，它观察到威胁行为者利用 2024 年 12 月修补的漏洞来攻击运行过时版本 DSM 的设备。 “这些攻击的目的是加密数据并勒索赎金，”它在一份声明中表示。
content:
Synology NAS 设备成为利用已修补的 DSM 漏洞进行勒索软件攻击的目标
Synology NAS 设备成为利用已修补的 DSM 漏洞进行勒索软件攻击的目标
Ravie Lakshmanan报告2026年11月3日勒索软件/网络攻击
在遭受勒索软件攻击后，Synology 敦促客户更新为其网络附加存储 (NAS) 设备提供支持的 DiskStation Manager (DSM) 软件。
这家台湾供应商表示，它观察到威胁行为者利用 2024 年 12 月修补的漏洞来攻击运行过时版本 DSM 的设备。
“这些攻击的目的是加密数据并勒索赎金，”该公司在上周发布的一份声明中表示。
虽然 Synology 没有透露这些攻击中利用的确切安全漏洞，但该公司链接到 2024 年 11 月的安全公告，其中列出了三个漏洞 -
CVE-2024-10441（CVSS 评分：9.8）- DSM 系统插件守护程序中存在不正确编码或转义输出漏洞，可能导致通过未指定向量远程执行代码。
CVE-2024-50629（CVSS 评分：5.3）- DSM 的 webapi 组件中存在不正确的编码或转义输出漏洞，可能允许远程攻击者通过未指定的向量读取有限的文件。
CVE-2024-10445（CVSS 评分：4.3）- DSM 更新功能中存在不正确的证书验证漏洞，可能允许远程攻击者通过未指定的向量写入有限的文件。
这些问题在以下版本中得到解决 -
DSM 7.2.2 - 升级至 7.2.2-72806-1 或更高版本
DSM 7.2.1 - 升级至 7.2.1-69057-6 或更高版本
DSM 7.2 - 升级至 7.2-64570-4 或更高版本
DSM 7.1 - 升级至 7.1.1-42962-7 或更高版本
DSM 6.2 - 升级至 6.2.4-25556-8 或更高版本
这一进展正值客户报告称他们的 Synology 设备遭到 C3RB3R 勒索软件攻击，该勒索软件被发现用“.L0CK3D”扩展名锁定用户文件。
这并不是 NAS 设备第一次成为勒索软件攻击的目标。 2019 年，台湾 QNAP Systems 制造的 NAS 设备遭到 QNAPCrypt（又名 eCh0raix）勒索软件的攻击。
然后，在 2021 年 8 月，Synology 警告称，由名为 StealthWorker 的恶意软件家族驱动的暴力攻击会导致勒索软件感染。
当时表示：“这些攻击利用许多已受感染的设备来尝试猜测常见的管理凭据，如果成功，将访问系统以安装其恶意负载，其中可能包括勒索软件。” “受感染的设备可能会对其他基于 Linux 的设备（包括 Synology NAS）发起额外攻击。”
同月，Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 还披露了 eCh0raix 变体的详细信息，该变体针对 QNAP 和 Synology 的 NAS 设备，利用 CVE-2021-28799 等漏洞或利用常用的管理凭据进行暴力破解。
“Synology 强烈敦促所有运行易受攻击版本的用户立即更新 DSM 以保护他们的系统，”该公司表示。 “Synology 还建议启用自动更新，以使 DSM 始终保持最新状态。”

Synology NAS Devices Targeted in Ransomware Attacks Exploiting Patched DSM Flaw
Synology NAS Devices Targeted in Ransomware Attacks Exploiting Patched DSM Flaw
Ravie LakshmananNov 03, 2026Ransomware / Cyber Attack
Synology is urging customers to update the DiskStation Manager (DSM) software powering its Network Attached Storage (NAS) devices following ransomware attacks.
The Taiwanese vendor said it observed threat actors exploiting a vulnerability patched in December 2024 to target devices running outdated versions of DSM.
"These attacks aim to encrypt data and extort ransom," it said in a statement released last week.
While Synology did not disclose the exact security flaw that's being exploited in these attacks, the company linked to a November 2024 security advisory that listed three vulnerabilities -
CVE-2024-10441 (CVSS score: 9.8) - An improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the system plugin daemon of DSM that could lead to remote code execution via unspecified vectors.
CVE-2024-50629 (CVSS score: 5.3) - An improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the webapi component of DSM that could allow remote attackers to read limited files via unspecified vectors.
CVE-2024-10445 (CVSS score: 4.3) - An improper certificate validation vulnerability in the update functionality in DSM that could allow remote attackers to write limited files via unspecified vectors.
The issues were addressed in the following versions -
DSM 7.2.2 - Upgrade to 7.2.2-72806-1 or above
DSM 7.2.1 - Upgrade to 7.2.1-69057-6 or above
DSM 7.2 - Upgrade to 7.2-64570-4 or above
DSM 7.1 - Upgrade to 7.1.1-42962-7 or above
DSM 6.2 - Upgrade to 6.2.4-25556-8 or above
The development comes amid reports from customers that their Synology devices have been hit by C3RB3R ransomware, which has been observed locking users' files with a ".L0CK3D" extension.
This is not the first time NAS devices have been the target of ransomware attacks. In 2019, NAS devices manufactured by Taiwan-based QNAP Systems were compromised by QNAPCrypt (aka eCh0raix) ransomware.
Then, in August 2021, Synology warned of brute-force attacks driven by a malware family called StealthWorker that led to ransomware infections.
"These attacks leverage a number of already infected devices to try and guess common administrative credentials, and if successful, will access the system to install its malicious payload, which may include ransomware," it said at the time. "Devices infected may carry out additional attacks on other Linux-based devices, including Synology NAS."
That same month, Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 also disclosed details of an eCh0raix variant targeting NAS devices from both QNAP and Synology by leveraging vulnerabilities like CVE-2021-28799 or brute-force their way in by making use of commonly used administrative credentials.
"Synology strongly urges all users running vulnerable versions to update DSM immediately to protect their systems," the company said. "Synology also recommends enabling automatic updates to keep DSM up to date at all times."

港股连续第三日上涨 恒指涨132点
11 月 3 日，港股连续第三个交易日上涨，恒生指数收高 132 点。消费者和游戏股领涨，而人工智能和芯片股大幅下跌。
港股11月3日连续第三天上涨，恒生指数收报23,525点，升132点或近0.6%。交易波动较大，盘中波动幅度略高于 200 点，但该指数最终收于日高点附近。据香港电台报道，主板成交额升至逾 2,364 亿港元。
科技指数上涨 0.7%，至 3,867 点。所谓的ATMXJ股票——阿里巴巴、腾讯、美团、小米和京东——均上涨，其中京东涨幅最大，接近6%。
消费类股强劲上涨。火锅连锁店海底捞和旅游公司携程集团均上涨超过6%，成为表现最好的两只蓝筹股。赌场股继续攀升：金沙中国和银河娱乐上涨3%至4%。
房地产和公用事业股也上涨。恒隆地产和华润置地涨幅接近3%或以上，华润电力涨幅超过2%，中华煤气和中电控股涨幅均超过1%。
相比之下，人工智能概念股、芯片股则大幅下跌。智普、MiniMax和天舒智信均下跌近8%或以上，联想集团跌幅超过6%。医药股和石油股也下跌。

Hong Kong stocks rise for third day, Hang Seng Index up 132 points | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 3 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong stocks rise for third day, Hang Seng Index up 132 points
Hong Kong shares extended gains for a third straight session on 3 November, with the Hang Seng Index closing 132 points higher. Consumer and gaming stocks led gains, while AI and chip stocks fell sharply.
Hong Kong stocks rose for a third consecutive day on 3 November, with the Hang Seng Index closing at 23,525 points, up 132 points or nearly 0.6 per cent. Trading was volatile, with an intraday range of just over 200 points, but the index finished near its daily high. Turnover on the main board rose to more than HK$236.4 billion, according to RTHK.
The technology index gained 0.7 per cent to 3,867 points. The so-called ATMXJ stocks—Alibaba, Tencent, Meituan, Xiaomi and JD.com—all rose, with JD.com recording the largest gain of nearly 6 per cent.
Consumer stocks posted strong gains. Hotpot chain Haidilao and travel firm Trip.com Group both rose more than 6 per cent, making them the two best-performing blue-chip stocks. Casino stocks continued to climb: Sands China and Galaxy Entertainment rose between 3 per cent and 4 per cent.
Property and utility stocks also advanced. Hang Lung Properties and China Resources Land gained nearly 3 per cent or more, China Resources Power rose more than 2 per cent, and Hong Kong and China Gas Company and CLP Holdings each added more than 1 per cent.
In contrast, artificial-intelligence concept stocks and chip stocks fell sharply. ZhiPu, MiniMax and Tian Shu Zhi Xin each dropped nearly 8 per cent or more, while Lenovo Group fell more than 6 per cent. Pharmaceutical and oil stocks also declined.

summary: 香港土地搜查改革引发对媒体访问的担忧中国劳工布告栏 2026 年 11 月 3 日星期二·香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 香港土地搜寻改革引发对媒体访问的担忧 香港拟议的土地搜寻改革将搜寻范围限制为九个目的，不包括新闻报道。立法者警告说，这可能会妨碍调查性新闻报道，而政府则捍卫一到两天的批准窗口，并指出司法审查是被拒绝的申请人的追索权。香港立法会法律顾问提出20多项质疑
content:
香港土地搜查改革引发对媒体访问的担忧中国劳工公告栏
星期二, 3 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港土地搜查改革引发对媒体访问的担忧
香港拟议的土地搜查改革将搜查限制为九个目的，不包括新闻报道。立法者警告说，这可能会妨碍调查性新闻报道，而政府则捍卫一到两天的批准窗口，并指出司法审查是被拒绝的申请人的追索权。
香港立法会的法律顾问就政府收紧媒体查阅香港土地记录的计划提出了 20 多个问题，立法者警告称这些变化可能会妨碍调查报道。周二，在立法会小组委员会第一次会议上提出了这些担忧，该小组委员会审查了与业权注册制度（TRS）相关的八项附属法例。
根据拟议的修正案，契约登记系统的搜索将仅限于九个目的，包括学术和市场研究。然而，新闻报道不属于指定用途，以公共利益为由寻求记录的申请人必须声明他们将如何使用这些数据，并由土地注册处处长决定具体情况。立法会法律顾问在致政府的信中提出了20多个有关拒绝理由以及复核或上诉机制的问题。该顾问还询问是否会公布符合条件的公共利益案件清单，并提到政府早些时候对大规模非法建筑和无主财产进行新闻调查的例子。
立法会议员霍启刚早些时候致信该委员会，表示媒体搜索应遵循明确的规则，但当局也必须“合理平衡隐私与公众权利”。 “对于合法的新闻采访来说，太宽松总是比太严格要好，”霍写道。然而，霍克退出了该委员会，因为他将在北京出席全国人民代表大会，并指出他不想拖延审议或阻止其他议员加入。
前记者、立法会议员陈海恩对将公共利益申请留给登记官个人判断的建议提出质疑，并警告说这会阻碍记者的工作。陈茂波指出，调查工作中界限模糊，金融调查经常会发现与公共利益无关的问题，例如非法搭建物或新界原住民非法出售小型屋宇建筑权。她进一步引用了一个案例，记者的搜查发现涉嫌柬埔寨诈骗集团在山顶拥有 11 处豪华房产，这一发现促使司法部冻结了这些资产。她警告说，如果没有上诉机制，注册服务商可能会在不考虑媒体观点的情况下拒绝申请。她建议，在政府信息服务部门注册的认可媒体应被视为符合公共利益目的，前提是申请由法定代表人或新闻编辑室负责人提出。
发展局常任秘书长何佩玲回应时澄清，有关楼市学术研究或分析的范畴，亦适用于媒体有关楼市或楼市的报道。她补充说，当媒体无法将其作品适合特定目的时，可以以公共利益为由提出申请，并由注册官权衡。

Hong Kong land search reform raises concerns over media access | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 3 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong land search reform raises concerns over media access
Hong Kong's proposed land search reforms limit searches to nine purposes, excluding news reporting. Lawmakers warn this could hamper investigative journalism, while the government defends a one-to-two-day approval window and points to judicial review as recourse for rejected applicants.
Legal advisers at Hong Kong's Legislative Council have raised more than 20 questions over government plans to tighten media access to the city's land records, with lawmakers warning the changes may hamper investigative reporting. The concerns were raised on Tuesday at the first meeting of a LegCo subcommittee examining eight pieces of subsidiary legislation tied to the Title Registration System (TRS).
Under the proposed amendments, searches of the deed registration system would be limited to nine purposes, including academic and market research. However, news reporting is not among the specified purposes, and applicants seeking records on public-interest grounds would have to declare how they would use the data, with the Land Registrar deciding each case. In a letter to the government, LegCo's legal adviser raised more than 20 questions about grounds for refusal and a review or appeal mechanism. The adviser also asked whether a list of qualifying public-interest cases would be published, pointing to the government's earlier example of a news investigation into large-scale illegal structures and ownerless properties.
Lawmaker Kenneth Fok Kai-kong wrote to the committee earlier, saying media searches should follow clear rules but the authorities must also 'reasonably balance privacy with the public's right.' 'It is always better to be too loose than too tight to legitimate newsgathering,' Fok wrote. However, Fok withdrew from the committee because he is due in Beijing to attend the National People's Congress, noting he did not want to hold up deliberations or block other lawmakers from joining.
Lawmaker Rebecca Chan Hoi-yan, a former journalist, challenged the proposal to leave public-interest applications to the registrar's individual judgment, warning it would box in reporters. Pointing to blurred lines in investigative work, Chan said financial probes often uncover unrelated public-interest issues, such as illegal structures or the illegal sale of small-house building rights by New Territories indigenous villagers. She further cited a case where reporters' searches exposed suspected Cambodian scam syndicates holding 11 luxury properties on The Peak — a revelation that prompted the Department of Justice to freeze the assets. Without an appeal mechanism, she warned, the registrar could reject an application without considering the media's perspective. She proposed that accredited media registered with the Government Information Services be deemed to qualify under the public-interest purpose, provided the application is filed by a legal representative or newsroom head.
In response, Permanent Secretary for Development Doris Ho Pui-ling clarified that the category covering academic research or analysis of the property market would also apply to media reports on property or the housing market. She added that media can apply on public-interest grounds when they cannot fit their work under a specified purpose, with the registrar weighing public interest against personal privacy. The system was not designed to facilitate investigative reporting, Ho said, stressing non-property-related applications must be handled cautiously. She further defended the one-to-two-day approval window as reasonable to stakeholders, arguing it will have limited impact because investigative reporting requires lengthy preparation.
Land Registrar Bruno Luk Kar-kin explained that the proposed system draws on the Transport Department's register of vehicles, which has been upheld in judicial review. Citing primary legislation, he noted that applicants must have a specified purpose. While the registrar's decisions can be appealed to the courts, he said the law did not cover the refusal of a new land search application. For applicants who disagree with the registrar's decision, he pointed to judicial review, adding that an appeal mechanism or improving the system would require amending the primary legislation.

summary: 前电子竞技冠军 Toyz 因在台湾吸毒被判驱逐至香港 |中国劳工布告栏 星期二, 2026 年 11 月 3 日 · 香港 香港和中国英文劳工新闻 前电子竞技冠军 Toyz 在台湾贩毒后被驱逐到香港 刘伟健 (Kurtis Lau Wai-kin)，又名 Toyz，因贩运大麻电子烟弹被判四年两个月的刑期，服刑两年多后，于周日被从台湾驱逐到香港。这位32岁的前英雄联盟世界冠军于10月20日获得假释，随后被驱逐出香港电竞影响者和实习生
content:
前电子竞技冠军 Toyz 因在台湾吸毒被判驱逐至香港 |中国劳工公告栏
星期二, 3 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
前电子竞技冠军 Toyz 因在台湾吸毒被判驱逐至香港
刘伟健（Kurtis Lau Wai-kin），又名 Toyz，因贩运大麻电子烟弹被判四年两个月的刑期，服刑两年多后，于周日被从台湾驱逐到香港。这位32岁的前英雄联盟世界冠军于10月20日获得假释，随后被驱逐出境
香港电子竞技影响者和网络名人刘伟健（Kurtis Lau Wai-kin），俗称“Toyz”，因贩运大麻电子烟弹而入狱两年多并获得假释，于周日被台湾当局驱逐回香港。
这位 32 岁的前职业选手于 2021 年在台中被捕后被判处四年两个月的监禁。服刑期过半后，刘于 10 月 20 日获得假释，检察官下令立即将他驱逐出境，以取代当地的缓刑监督。
台湾移民署证实，刘最初因商业原因前往台湾，后来因销售大麻电子烟弹而被起诉并定罪。在检察机关发出以驱逐取代缓刑的指令后，周日，移民官员将刘直接护送至机场，执行强制驱逐令。当局证实刘已被禁止入境，禁止他在指定期限内返回台湾。
今年早些时候有媒体报道称，刘在一月份服刑期间与台湾艺人贤孝其登记结婚。当时有传言称，该工会旨在建立居住理由并阻止他最终被遣返香港，但此举最终未能阻止移民当局执行驱逐令。对于未来的可能性，移民署表示，如果刘随后提出通过配偶担保在台湾居留的任何申请，官员将根据法定移民法规对案件进行严格审查。
刘最初在国际上崭露头角是在 2012 年，当时他带领台湾职业电子竞技队台北刺客队在洛杉矶举行的英雄联盟世界锦标赛第二赛季中取得历史性胜利。从高水平竞技游戏退役后，刘选择在台湾定居，将自己重塑为受欢迎的 YouTube 创作者和游戏直播主播，以直率的评论和美食评论而闻名，但法律问题导致他的直播生涯戛然而止。

Tuesday, 3 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Former esports champion Toyz deported to Hong Kong after Taiwan drug sentence
Kurtis Lau Wai-kin, known as Toyz, was deported from Taiwan to Hong Kong on Sunday after serving over two years of a four-year-two-month sentence for trafficking marijuana vape cartridges. The 32-year-old former League of Legends world champion was granted parole on October 20, then expelled rather
Hong Kong esports influencer and internet celebrity Kurtis Lau Wai-kin, widely known as Toyz, was deported back to Hong Kong by Taiwanese authorities on Sunday after serving over two years in prison for trafficking marijuana vape cartridges and securing parole.
The 32-year-old former professional gamer had been handed a four-year-two-month custodial sentence following his 2021 arrest in Taichung. After serving more than half of his term, Lau was granted parole on October 20, prompting prosecutors to order his immediate deportation in place of local probationary supervision.
Taiwan's National Immigration Agency confirmed that Lau originally travelled to Taiwan on business grounds before his prosecution and conviction for selling cannabis vape cartridges. Following the prosecutorial directive replacing probation with expulsion, immigration officers escorted Lau directly to the airport on Sunday to carry out the compulsory deportation order. Authorities confirmed that Lau has been placed on an entry ban that bars him from returning to Taiwan for a designated period.
Media reports earlier this year revealed that Lau registered his marriage with Taiwanese entertainer Hsyan Hsiaochi while serving his prison term in January. Speculation circulated at the time that the union was intended to establish residency grounds and prevent his eventual repatriation to Hong Kong, though the move ultimately failed to stop immigration authorities from carrying out the expulsion order. Addressing future possibilities, the National Immigration Agency indicated that should Lau submit any subsequent application to reside in Taiwan through spousal sponsorship, officials will subject the case to rigorous examination in accordance with statutory immigration regulations.
Lau originally rose to international prominence in 2012 when he led the Taiwanese professional esports squad Taipei Assassins to a historic victory at the Season 2 League of Legends World Championship in Los Angeles. Following his retirement from high-level competitive gaming, Lau chose to settle in Taiwan, reinventing himself as a popular YouTube creator and gaming live-streamer known for his forthright commentary and food reviews before his legal troubles brought his streaming career to an abrupt halt.
